title: Intelligent Three Level Learning Architecture for Autonomous UAV Swarms in Search and Rescue
summary: This paper presents a novel three level hierarchical learning architecture for autonomous UAV swarms performing search and rescue operations. Unlike conventional approaches that apply a single learning paradigm across all hierarchy levels, the proposed architecture integrates three qualitatively different learning mechanisms corresponding to the biological hierarchy of reflexes, skills, and reasoning such as Hebbian neuroplasticity for individual agent adaptation, multi agent reinforcement learning with graph neural networks and behavior trees for tactical coordination, and model agnostic meta learning with BDI reasoning and a digital twin for strategic decision making. The architecture is formalized through twenty two architectural contracts organized across six components such as BDI, Behavior Trees, GNN, MARL, Neuroplasticity, Meta Learning that collectively provide six classes of formal guarantees such as safety, budget correctness, optimality, liveness, starvation freedom, and inter level consistency. We introduce Swarm Meta Cognition as a compositional property arising from the structured interaction of all three levels, enabling the swarm to monitor its own cognitive state and switch between cognitive strategies. Five constructive progress functions for SAR task types bridge the gap between abstract optimization theory and concrete operational scenarios. The main integration theorem establishes that when all contracts are satisfied, the hybrid neuro-symbolic system preserves all six guarantee classes. For the dynamic case with active learning, five new contracts extend the framework with three additional guarantees such as cognitive resilience, graceful degradation, and monotonic meta improvement. Theoretical analysis demonstrates that the architecture addresses five fundamental limitations of existing hierarchical RL approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于自主无人机集群执行搜索与救援（SAR）任务的三层分层学习架构，将反射、技能、推理三级生物层级与异构学习机制（Hebbian神经可塑性、MARL+GNN+行为树、MAML+BDI+数字孪生）相结合，通过22个架构契约和6类形式化保证（安全性、预算正确性、最优性、活性、无饥饿性、层级间一致性）实现神经-符号混合系统的形式化集成，并引入"集群元认知"组合属性和五种SAR进度函数。
AI.motivation: 现有分层强化学习方法存在五项根本性局限：单一学习范式难以兼顾多时间尺度决策、缺乏对系统认知状态的自监控与策略切换能力、神经-符号系统集成缺乏统一形式化保证、动态环境下的认知弹性与优雅降级机制不足，以及难以桥接抽象优化理论与具体SAR作战场景之间的鸿沟。本文旨在通过生物启发的异构分层架构与严格形式化契约体系弥补上述缺陷。
AI.method: 方法采用三层生物启发的混合架构：①反射层使用Hebbian神经可塑性实现单体快速适应；②技能层结合MARL、GNN与行为树实现战术协调；③推理层融合MAML、BDI推理与数字孪生进行战略决策。形式化层面定义22个架构契约（覆盖BDI、行为树、GNN、MARL、神经可塑性、元学习6个组件），推出主集成定理证明满足所有契约时六类保证成立；动态场景下扩展5个新契约，提供认知弹性、优雅降级与单调元改进保证；引入5种SAR构造性进度函数作为理论到作战的桥梁。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，所提架构成功解决了现有分层强化学习方法的五项根本性局限；当全部静态契约满足时，主集成定理保证神经-符号混合系统同时维持六类形式化保证（安全性、预算正确性、最优性、活性、无饥饿性、层级间一致性）；在主动学习的动态场景下，扩展的5个契约进一步引入认知弹性、优雅降级与单调元改进三类保证；"集群元认知"作为三层结构化交互涌现的组合属性，使集群能够自监控认知状态并切换认知策略。
AI.conclusion: 本文构建了一套兼具生物学合理性与严格形式化保证的分层学习架构，将异构学习机制通过契约式方法统一为可验证的神经-符号系统，为SAR等复杂任务中无人机集群的自主性、可验证性与适应性提供了系统性的理论基础与架构蓝图。

title: HG-RAG: Hierarchy-Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Structured Knowledge Graphs
summary: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) has proven to be a widely successful process at improving the quality of outputs from a Large Language Model (LLM) for wider context. However, RAG systems typically retrieve context from flat document stores, which struggles when queries require hierarchical or relational reasoning across structured knowledge. I present HG-RAG (Hierarchy-Guided RAG), a framework that performs graph-traversal over a hierarchical knowledge graph to deliver structured context to a language model. My retrieval pipeline resolves a named entity anchor from the query, then expands context upward through parent nodes, laterally through relational neighbors, and downward through child nodes when needed. I evaluate HG-RAG against a dense retrieval baseline across three world scales (18-800 nodes) with four query types: local fact, hierarchical, neighborhood, and multi-hop. Results show HG-RAG consistently outperforms the flat baseline on hierarchical, relational, and multi-hop reasoning tasks, while reducing hallucination and maintaining locality coherence.

AI.tldr: HG-RAG 是一种面向结构化层次知识图谱的检索增强生成框架，通过图遍历（向上/横向/向下）取代传统的扁平密集检索，在层次、关系和多跳推理任务上显著优于基于向量相似度的基线，尤其在图规模增大时优势更明显。
AI.motivation: 现有 RAG 系统通常从扁平文档库中检索上下文，当查询需要跨越结构化知识进行层次化或关系推理时表现不佳；语义相似度无法捕捉节点在层次结构中的位置关系，导致事实性准确率随图规模增大而崩溃、容易产生虽然内部一致但事实错误的回答。作者主张结构化知识需要结构化检索。
AI.method: 1) 构建三层次合成知识图谱（行星→国家→城市），使用 NetworkX 实现，节点附带属性，边包含结构边（contains）和关系边（borders、trade_with、hostile、unfriendly、neutral）；2) 提出四阶段检索流水线：实体解析（LLM+模糊匹配兜底）→ 向上锚定 k-up → 横向遍历 k-side（敌对/不友好邻居优先）→ 向下遍历 k_down；3) 检索子图上限 15 个节点，序列化为带位置链和标签块的提示；4) 基线为 nomic-embed-text 嵌入+余弦相似度的 top-10 密集检索；5) 使用 Mistral 7B（Ollama, Q4_K_M）作为生成与评判模型；6) 三种规模（约 18/150/800 节点）× 四类查询（local fact、hierarchical、neighborhood、multi-hop），50 条确定性生成查询×5 轮试验。
AI.result: 整体事实准确性：基线在小世界为 1.004，随规模骤降至中世界 0.242、大世界 0.022；HG-RAG 稳定在 1.79–1.86。层次与本地事实查询上 HG-RAG 在各规模均获满分 2.00，基线在中/大规模为 0。多跳 LLM 评分呈反向趋势：基线 3.45→2.82→1.66（随规模退化），HG-RAG 3.23→3.88→4.10（随规模提升）。位置感知 HG-RAG 全场景保持 1.00，基线在大规模多跳上跌至 0.75。幻觉率方面两者均较低，但 HG-RAG 在中规模 local fact 上出现 0.125 的异常值。小世界差距收窄归因于 15 节点子图上限几乎覆盖全图，以及基线本身在低噪声环境中检索压力较小。
AI.conclusion: 层次感知检索在结构化知识上优于纯语义检索，且优势随图规模扩大而增强；语义相似度无法替代对节点层级位置的理解。论文也坦承局限：固定 15 节点上限、生成模型与评判模型同为 Mistral 7B 存在自我一致性偏差、无命名实体查询和反向属性查询当前无法处理，未来可通过自适应子图大小、独立评判模型及属性过滤子例程改进。

title: IMEX Interaction-Based Model Explanation
summary: In predictive modeling, the ability to explain why a model produces a given target prediction has become increasingly important [5, 10]. Black-box models do not provide a transparent description of the internal mechanisms that generate the prediction, making even accurate predictions difficult to interpret and validate. In critical contexts, predictive accuracy alone is not a sufficient validation metric if the reasons underlying model decisions remain unexplained. The IMEX (Interaction-Based Model Explanation) approach represents a methodological direction within explainable predictive modeling. IMEX is designed to identify which variables contribute most to the target prediction and which interactions among variables are significant in determining the target. The method does not impose limitations on higher-order interaction analysis, allowing the investigation of feature subsets with cardinality greater than two. Beyond the identification of feature importance, IMEX enables the exploration of interaction patterns that may be consistent with latent mechanisms influencing the outcome. Through the application of the IMEX algorithm, it is possible to construct an interpretability map of the predictions. The IMEX framework is built on two complementary metrics: Static Correlation Power (PCS), which quantifies the contribution of individual features, and Interaction Correlation Power (PCI), which captures non-additive effects among features. In the present work, the PCS component is experimentally validated through a comparison with INVASE [18] on three synthetic datasets with known structures. The results indicate that IMEX can recover relevant feature-level structures in the presence of non-linear, conditional, and multicollinear relationships between input features and prediction targets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为 IMEX（基于交互的模型解释）的可解释性框架，通过两个互补指标——PCS（静态关联强度，用于衡量单特征贡献）与 PCI（交互关联强度，用于捕捉非加性交互效应）——对黑箱模型进行事后解释。当前工作重点在 PCS 层面，通过与 INVASE 在三个具有已知依赖结构的合成数据集上的对比实验，验证了 IMEX 在非线性、条件性及多重共线性场景下恢复相关特征结构的能力。
AI.motivation: 机器学习与深度学习模型在关键应用场景中缺乏透明性，仅凭预测精度不足以满足验证需求。现有的 XAI 方法主要分为特征重要性识别（如 INVASE）、加性归因分解（如 LIME、SHAP）以及交互效应量化（如 SHAP interaction values）三大类，但缺少一种能够同时统一处理单特征贡献与高阶交互效应、且对多重共线性和条件依赖结构具有鲁棒性的解释框架。
AI.method: 方法核心定义两个度量：(1) PCS——通过逐一移除特征后预测值的变化量 Δyᵢ,ₖ 占总变化量的比例来量化单特征重要性；(2) PCI——通过联合移除一对特征后的预测变化量与两个单特征变化量之和的绝对差 Iᵢⱼ 来衡量非加性交互效应，并对其在涉及相关特征的所有交互项之和上进行归一化。框架进一步推广至高阶交互（子集 |S|=m≥2）。实验采用 XGBoost 作为预测模型，在三个合成数据集（实体店购买、线上购买、加油站）上，以基于数据生成规则构建的二元真值表为基准，利用基线 1.2 倍的阈值将连续重要性得分二值化，通过精确率、召回率与 F1 分数将 IMEX (PCS) 与 INVASE 进行比较。
AI.result: 在三个数据集的多个预测目标上，PCS 总体上能有效恢复与真值结构一致的特征重要性信号。(1) 数据集 1（实体店购买）：在逆比例、条件关系下两种方法基本一致，但在多重共线性场景（如 Promo Spend 目标）中，PCS 能捕获更广泛的相关结构，INVASE 仅识别单一主相关；(2) 数据集 2（线上购买）：在强相关场景下两种方法一致，但在弱相关信号检测上 PCS 表现出更高灵敏度；(3) 数据集 3（加油站）：在条件性、间接依赖场景中，PCS 比 INVASE 更敏感。PCI 在本文中仅作为理论扩展提出，尚未进行实证基准验证。
AI.conclusion: 本文确立了 IMEX 作为事后可解释性框架的双层结构：在特征重要性层面，PCS 通过受控合成实验获得实证支持，能够在异构依赖条件下保持一致性；在交互层面，PCI 提供了一个原理上可与 SHAP interaction values 进行结构对比的度量空间。本文确认 IMEX 与 INVASE 可被视为在不同场景下互补的方法。未来工作重点在于 PCI 对交互导向方法的实证基准验证，以及构建融合强度与交互模式的特征依赖结构连接图。

title: RegNetAgents: A Multi-Agent Framework for Cross-Network Regulatory Driver Identification in Cancer Genomics
summary: We introduce RegNetAgents, an AI-oriented multi-agent framework for structured, query-driven regulatory candidate identification across heterogeneous gene regulatory networks. The system enables unified analysis of bulk tumor and single-cell-derived ARACNe networks by integrating TCGA-derived cancer networks with large-scale single-cell regulatory networks from the GREmLN project. For a given focal gene, the framework performs dual-network classification, cancer gene filtering using OncoKB annotations, and mode-of-action (MoA) assignment for tumor-derived regulatory relationships. Candidates are ranked by evidence consistency across networks (Both, TCGA-only, GREmLN-only). The system is implemented as a multi-agent LangGraph DAG workflow, accessible through a unified Python API and Model Context Protocol (MCP) client, operating as a downstream analytical layer over precomputed regulatory networks rather than a network inference method. Across eleven breast cancer (BRCA) and twelve colorectal cancer (COAD) focal genes, RegNetAgents identifies candidate regulators significantly enriched for OncoKB-annotated cancer genes. TCGA-derived candidates show strong enrichment (Stouffer Z = 6.69 for BRCA and 6.95 for COAD), while GREmLN-derived candidates also demonstrate significant enrichment (Z = 5.51 for BRCA and 7.06 for COAD; all p < 0.0001). No enrichment is observed in housekeeping or non-driver control gene sets, supporting signal specificity. An extended module enables structured evaluation of oncogenic potential, druggability, clinical relevance, and network vulnerability, supporting end-to-end interpretation from candidate identification to biological hypothesis generation. RegNetAgents establishes an interpretable AI framework for cross-network regulatory candidate identification in cancer genomics.

AI.tldr: RegNetAgents是一个面向AI的多智能体框架，基于LangGraph DAG工作流，通过TCGA批量肿瘤网络与GREmLN单细胞调控网络的双网络整合分析，实现结构化、查询驱动的调控候选基因识别，并在BRCA和COAD数据中验证了对OncoKB注释癌基因的显著富集。
AI.motivation: 现有基因调控网络推断方法产生的异质性网络（bulk tumor与single-cell来源）缺乏统一的、可解释的AI驱动分析层；研究人员难以系统性地跨网络识别与特定靶基因相关的癌症相关调控因子，并评估其致癌潜力、药物靶向性与临床相关性。
AI.method: 构建基于LangGraph的多智能体DAG工作流，对焦点基因执行双网络分类（TCGA-derived ARACNe网络 + GREmLN单细胞调控网络）、OncoKB癌基因过滤、调控关系的肿瘤来源MoA分配；候选基因按网络证据一致性（Both / TCGA-only / GREmLN-only）排序；通过统一Python API与MCP客户端访问，并包含致癌潜力、药物靶向性、临床相关性、网络脆弱性的扩展评估模块。
AI.result: 在11个BRCA和12个COAD焦点基因上，TCGA来源候选基因显著富集OncoKB注释癌基因（BRCA Z=6.69，COAD Z=6.95），GREmLN来源候选基因同样显著富集（BRCA Z=5.51，COAD Z=7.06，所有p<0.0001）；管家基因与非驱动对照基因集未观察到富集，证实信号特异性。
AI.conclusion: RegNetAgents建立了一个可解释的AI框架，用于跨网络的癌症基因组调控候选基因识别，实现了从候选识别到生物学假设生成的端到端解读，并可作为预计算调控网络之上的下游分析层推广使用。

title: DialogueVPR: Towards Conversational Visual Place Recognition
summary: Inspired by how humans communicate spatial information, language-guided geo-localization has gained significant traction for its intuitive and practical value. Despite this progress, most methods still rely on a static, one-shot retrieval paradigm, which fails to handle the ambiguity and incompleteness inherent in real-world natural language descriptions. We propose a paradigm shift to reasoning retrieval and introduce Dialogue Place Recognition (DlgPR), which casts localization as an interactive, dialogue-driven reasoning process. To support this new task, we present DlgQuest-Cities, the first large-scale dialogue-based benchmark for place recognition, and a unified reasoning framework that couples a cross-modal multi-level retriever with an intelligent questioner, DQ-pilot. DQ-pilot is trained in a curriculum: supervised fine-tuning on a curated DQ-cities-20k subset followed by reinforcement refinement on a harder DQ-cities-10k split via GRPO. Two task-aligned metrics guide learning: a Discriminative Difficulty Index (DDI) for curriculum sampling and a Positional Retrieval Gain (PRG) reward that directly measures retrieval improvement induced by a question. Experiments show this reasoning-based approach significantly outperforms baselines. The code and model are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的视觉位置识别范式——对话式位置识别（Dialogue Place Recognition, DlgPR），将传统的一次性静态检索转变为交互式、对话驱动的推理过程。作者构建了首个大规模对话式位置识别基准数据集DlgQuest-Cities (DQ-cities)，并提出统一推理框架DlgQuest，包含跨模态渐进学习检索器（CMPL）和智能提问智能体DQ-pilot。DQ-pilot通过课程学习（SFT+GRPO）训练，使用判别性难度指数（DDI）和位置检索增益（PRG）作为任务对齐指标进行优化。
AI.motivation: 传统的语言引导地理定位方法采用静态一次性检索范式，无法处理现实世界中自然语言描述固有的歧义性和不完整性问题。当初始输入模糊或不完整时，这些系统无法主动寻求澄清或获取额外信息，因此在动态真实场景中表现脆弱。受人类交流空间信息方式的启发，作者主张地理定位应从被动检索进化到主动推理检索范式。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心部分：(1) 数据集构建DlgQuest-Cities：基于GSV-Cities构建，包含106,880张位置图像和30k对话样本，通过文本模态扩展、区域级视觉证据构建、Chain-of-Thought对话生成（GPT-4o驱动）和判别性难度感知课程采样四个阶段生成；(2) 跨模态渐进学习检索器（CMPL）：采用CLIP ViT-B/16骨干，通过显著性过滤模块、多层渐进特征对齐、分层相似度分布匹配和硬负样本隔离损失实现细粒度跨模态对齐；(3) 智能提问智能体DQ-pilot：基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct，通过两阶段课程学习训练——先在DQ-cities-20k（低DDI样本）上进行监督微调建立基础推理能力，再在DQ-cities-10k（高DDI样本）上使用GRPO强化学习进行优化，奖励函数结合格式奖励和PRG检索奖励。
AI.result: 实验在五个代表性城市（LosAngeles, BuenosAires, MexicoCity, Osaka等）上进行评估：(1) 交互式推理检索：完整DlgQuest（SFT+GRPO）在第5轮对话的R@1上比Qwen2.5-VL-7B提升13.4%，比Qwen2.5-VL-72B提升7.3%，并以最低BRI分数（1.18）表现出最优的交互效率；(2) 静态检索性能：CMPL检索器在细粒度长描述条件下显著优于CLIP、Long-CLIP、FG-CLIP、Flair等基线，在Osaka城市R@1达到82.5%；(3) 消融实验验证了各组件（Token选择、渐进HSDM、硬负样本隔离、课程学习、GRPO）的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DlgPR成功将传统静态地理定位转变为交互式推理驱动过程，证明了主动提问对真实世界地理定位的重要性。提出的统一推理框架DlgQuest结合大规模基准数据集DQ-Cities和DDI引导的课程学习，使DQ-Pilot能够通过对话迭代优化空间理解。实验表明该交互式推理方法显著提升了定位的鲁棒性和效率。未来工作将探索更自适应的对话策略、检索器-提问器协同训练以及在开放环境中具身智能体的实时部署策略。

title: Interpretable Language Model for Closed-Loop Type 1 Diabetes Control
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE 22nd International Conference on Automation Science and Engineering conference (IEEE CASE 2026)
summary: Type 1 Diabetes (T1D) is a chronic, life-threatening autoimmune condition characterized by the complete destruction of insulin-producing pancreatic beta cells. While Artificial Pancreas Systems (APS) powered by Reinforcement Learning (RL) have shown promise in automating insulin delivery, their ``black-box'' nature makes it hard for patients and doctors to trust them fully. This paper presents LLM-T1D, a promising approach that combines the precision of RL with the clear, human-like reasoning of Large Language Models (LLMs) to create a more transparent and reliable insulin pump controller. By training an expert RL system and distilling its knowledge into fine-tuned LLaMA 3.1 8B and Qwen3 8B models, we developed a controller that not only surpasses the RL system's performance but also explains its decisions in plain, understandable language. Tested on the FDA-approved UVA/Padova T1D simulator, the LLM controllers deliver excellent blood sugar control (73.5% Time in Range) while maintaining strict formal safety verification against hallucinations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LLM-T1D 框架，将强化学习（RL）专家控制器的策略蒸馏到 LLaMA 3.1 8B 和 Qwen3 8B 大语言模型中，构建可解释且安全的1型糖尿病闭环人工胰腺控制器。通过在 FDA 认可的 UVA/Padova 仿真器上测试，LLaMA 3.1 8B 在成人队列实现 73.5% 的目标血糖范围内时间（TIR），优于临床基线和 PPO 专家，同时将严重低血糖失败率从 2.79% 降至 1.60%，并通过确定性安全覆盖层防止 LLM 幻觉直接驱动硬件。
AI.motivation: RL 驱动的 APS 虽性能优越，但作为"黑盒"缺乏临床可解释性，阻碍患者和医生的信任与采纳。现有可解释 AI 方法（如决策树、模仿学习）在高维非线性血糖控制中存在可解释性差、协变量偏移或计算开销大等局限。同时，LLM 直接控制医疗硬件存在幻觉风险，因此需要一种兼顾性能、透明性与安全性的闭环胰岛素控制方案。
AI.method: 1) 采用 PPO+G2P2C 架构（辅助模型学习 + 蒙特卡洛规划）训练 RL 专家策略；2) 设计确定性文本化引擎（TE），将生理状态（CGM、IOB、餐食、趋势）转为结构化 JSON 提示；3) 通过 LoRA 参数高效微调将策略蒸馏至 LLaMA 3.1 8B 和 Qwen3 8B，使用 SFT 交叉熵损失；4) 部署确定性安全覆盖层：IOB 上限约束、RoC 锁定、语义-数值一致性异常检测、不可信时降级至低风险基础率；5) 在 UVA/Padova 仿真器对 10 名成人 + 10 名青少年虚拟患者进行 100 种随机场景测试。
AI.result: LLaMA 3.1 8B 在成人队列取得 73.50% TIR，优于 BBHE 临床基线（69.78%）和 PPO 专家（69.12%），且严重低血糖失败率从 PPO 的 2.79% 降至 1.60%（青少年从 4.93% 降至 1.48%），LBGI 显著降低；Qwen3 8B 表现次之但同样优于 PPO。90% 以上 LLM 生成解释经人工评估为临床合理且具教学价值。统计检验（Mann-Whitney U，P<0.05）验证改进显著性。量化语义 token 空间带来正则化平滑效应。
AI.conclusion: LLM-T1D 证明将 RL 策略蒸馏至语言模型可在不损失控制性能的前提下提供自然语言可解释性，并通过确定性安全层将 LLM 推理与硬件执行解耦，缓解幻觉风险。但该工作仅为临床前仿真研究，距离真实临床应用仍需验证传感器噪声、分布偏移、行为变异性下的鲁棒性，并推进边缘部署、回顾性回放及分阶段临床试验。

title: Human AI Construction of Bayesian Networks for Operational Decision Support -- A Virtual Survey Approach
summary: Bayesian Belief Networks (BBNs) are powerful tools for decision-making under uncertainty. However, building their structures and estimating parameters are difficult. Currently, researchers must choose between relying on expert judgement or using large datasets to learn the structure and parameters of the network. We propose a new methodology using Large Language Models to bridge the gap between expert opinion and data-driven learning. This approach uses a panel of AI agents to estimate probabilities based on specific personas and context. We then apply a trimmed-mean rule to remove noise from these responses. We develop a six step BBN framework and illustrate it to model customer intention to consult a doctor in an alternative healthcare system. The model reveals that while self efficacy appears to be a major factor, its actual causal impact is small. In contrast, subjective norms have a much stronger effect in modelling customers' intention. The most effective strategy is to improve both confidence and community norms simultaneously.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用大语言模型（LLMs）构建贝叶斯信念网络（BBN）的新方法，通过多智能体面板、特定人设情境下的概率估计以及去噪处理，弥合专家判断与数据驱动学习之间的鸿沟，并以替代医疗场景下的客户就医意愿建模为例进行验证。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯信念网络是处理不确定性决策的有力工具，但其结构构建与参数估计面临两难：要么依赖专家主观判断，要么需要大量数据集进行学习。前者主观性强、难以扩展，后者受限于数据可得性。作者旨在探索利用LLM作为折中方案，弥补二者之间的方法论空白。
AI.method: 提出六步法BBN框架：(1) 定义问题与变量；(2) 构建网络结构；(3) 组建由具有不同persona（如文化背景、专业身份等）的AI智能体组成的面板；(4) 各智能体依据人设和上下文独立估计条件概率；(5) 对智能体响应应用trimmed-mean规则剔除极端噪声值；(6) 综合生成BBN参数。最终将其应用于替代医疗情境下"客户就医意愿"建模，整合自我效能（self-efficacy）与主观规范（subjective norms）等社会认知构念。
AI.result: 模型揭示出一个"表面重要 vs. 实际因果"的反直觉差异：自我效能在直觉上似为主要因素，但其实际因果影响较小；而主观规范（社区/群体态度）对客户就医意愿的因果效应显著更强。分析表明，单独提升任一因素的效果有限。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出实践启示——在替代医疗营销或干预策略中，最有效的方案是同时提升客户信心（自我效能）与社区规范（主观规范），而非侧重单一维度；并验证了基于LLM多智能体面板结合trimmed-mean去噪来估计BBN概率的方法可行性，为小数据/无数据情境下的因果建模提供了新路径。

title: Capability from Access Structure, Not Scale: Lower Bounds and Pre-Registered Tests for Hybrid Sequence Models
comment: 41 pages, 16 figures. Pre-registered small-scale experiments (scorecard: 11 supported, 7 partial, 1 failed). Information-theoretic lower bounds plus controlled trained witnesses. Jianlin Chen and Ziyao Lin contributed equally. Corresponding author: Chi Man Vong (cmvong@um. this http URL )
summary: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) holds that as models scale, representations of heterogeneous networks converge toward a shared model of reality. We propose its sequel and boundary, the Capability Convergence Hypothesis (CCH): under a fixed per-token inference budget, representational convergence does not entail capability convergence. Capability instead converges toward a class, the access-complete hybrid: any architecture holding both a compressive O(1)-state channel and a scalable verbatim-index channel. We anchor it on a witness task, the Newton's-apple problem in an infinite stream, and name three resource walls: a Shannon wall barring any o(Nb)-state architecture, a horizon wall barring any fixed window, and a circuit wall barring fixed-depth attention-only composition (conditional on TC0 != NC1). Under an explicit separability assumption a hybrid crosses all three by paying each wall's price, so capability is strictly super-additive under composition. We separate what we prove from what we conjecture: the access-completeness principle rests on information-theoretic lower bounds and pre-registered experiments, while the field-level convergence trend is an economics-motivated conjecture. We report the first pre-registered small-scale tests under criteria frozen before the data: the predicted scissors gap is measured (exact-retrieval error 0.994 vs. 0.000 once a 64-scalar state gains one global-attention layer), the state-tracking bifurcation lands at the registered boundary, and a conjunction witness shows an irreducibly two-channel solution; one prediction failed with its direction reversed and is reported as such. Representational convergence is given freely by scale; capability convergence must be purchased by access structure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"能力收敛假说"(CCH)，作为"柏拉图表征假说"(PRH)的续篇与边界。CCH主张：在固定每token推理预算下，表征收敛不等于能力收敛；能力收敛于一个"访问完备的混合架构"类——同时具备压缩状态通道(O(1)更新)与可扩展逐字索引通道(Θ(L)内存)。论文以"无限流中的牛顿苹果问题"为核心见证任务，建立三堵资源墙(Shannon墙、Horizon墙、Circuit墙)，并报告首批预注册的小规模实验(19项预测中11项支持、7项部分支持、1项失败)。核心结论：表征收敛由规模免费赠予；能力收敛必须由访问结构购买。
AI.motivation: 动机源于PRH的一个裂隙：Usama与Chang发现模型可在表征层面高度对齐(CKA 0.83–0.90)却在推理计算上发散，尤其在决策时刻表征一致性骤降(post-decision CKA从0.875降至0.274)，且对齐度在模型集体失败的题目上反而更高(0.897 vs 0.830)。这表明"拥有好的表征"与"在固定预算下能用它进行计算"是两回事。论文追问：如果PRH回答"表征去向何方"，那么能力去向何方？作者认为答案不在表征而在访问结构(access structure)——查询时状态通道(query-time state channel)的容量是信息论硬约束，无法通过单纯放大模型绕过。
AI.method: 方法由三层证据组合：(1)信息论下界——基于数据处理不等式建立Shannon墙(Theorem 1)，给出独立绑定场景下精确检索的log-loss与误差概率下界 ℋ(V_I|Σ,I) ≥ b(1−1/x)，其中x=Nb/B为负载比；(2)见证任务——"无限流中的牛顿苹果问题"NA(N,b,B;κ)将单一事实植入10^7 token的语义干扰流中，定义协议Protocol 3作为单向通信博弈；(3)三堵墙的统一框架——Shannon墙(无条件)、Horizon墙(窗口截断，无条件)、Circuit墙(TC⁰≠NC¹条件下的固定深度组合)；(4)预注册小规模实验——在协议冻结后执行0.2–1.1M参数的小模型测试，包含剪刀差(Experiment B)、状态追踪分叉(Experiment C)、表征-能力解耦(Experiment A)、合取见证(Experiment E)；(5)Galois连接框架——以可解性关系诱导能力闭包算子，将"T∪S ⊋ T+S"的代数内容精确化为可证伪的能力超加性命题(Proposition 3)。此外，对140个生产架构进行人口普查，量化全局注意力占比ρ的集中带[1/12, 1/4]。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1)剪刀差被测量——同一64标量状态下，纯状态DeltaNet在N=128时精确检索误差为0.994，而加入一层全局注意力后的混合架构误差降至0.000(加倍预算后worst seed仅0.001)；(2)状态追踪分叉在预注册边界处成立——β∈(0,1)的DeltaNet在5×预算下仍拟合不了合成S₅，而β∈(0,2)单反射即可解决交换流于6.4×训练长度；n_h=4是合成的容量阈值(3/8 seeds通过)；(3)工业人口普查显示61个真正混合架构的ρ中位数为0.167，57%落在[1/12, 1/4]带内，3.4×富集于均匀分布；(4)表征-能力解耦成立——74个跨族配对的Spearman ρ=+0.48(对齐度正相关于能力差距而非负相关)；(5)P3通道可公度性失败，方向反转——解题模型的跨通道对齐低于随机初始化(0.284 vs 0.576)，P3'通道互补性部分成立(联合必要性：损伤任一通道坍缩至≤0.03；定位：答案从索引混合器线性可解码1.0 vs 状态混合器0.004)；(6)Assumption 1的零码距碰撞对照将混合架构精确钉在c/(c+1)模糊地板上，证明剪刀优势以可分离性为代价；(7)自然语料的表面形式可分离性测量：实体类键87.5%可分离，数字ID仅50.7%，代码标识符56.2%。总评分卡：19项预测中11支持/7部分/1失败；按主预测粒度P1、P2部分成立，P3失败，P4仅提示性(p≈0.06)，P5未测。
AI.conclusion: 结论：PRH主张表征收敛于同一个理想Z，由规模驱动、自由赠予；CCH主张能力收敛于"访问完备的混合架构"类(同时具备O(1)压缩状态通道与Θ(ρL)可扩展索引)，由推理经济学驱动、必须购买。能力闭包在架构组合下严格超加(𝒞∞(T⊔S) ⊋ 𝒞∞(T)∪𝒞∞(S))，本质原因是混合架构"付费通过"三堵墙的下界而非绕过它们：支付Ω(Nb)的索引容量换取Shannon墙的跨越，以1/ρ系数推迟Horizon墙(不消除)，以表达性递归(负特征值、Householder积)跨越Circuit墙。第一收敛(表征)免费，因为它不消耗查询时访问容量；第二收敛(能力)有代价，组合涌现(compositional emergence)是禁止"以纯规模白嫖能力"的关卡。论文明确区分已证明与已猜想：访问完备性原则由信息论下界与预注册实验支撑；产业级收敛趋势是经济学启发的猜想(非已观测现象)，R1–R4的普查证据仅为"consistent-with"而非判别性。机制级证据在0.2–1.1M参数小模型上成立；前沿规模验证、梯度下降是否能找到该构造、TC⁰≠NC¹的最终判定、以及嵌入级可分离性的自然语料发生率，均为开放问题。建议将"访问结构"作为模型卡与基准报告的一类变量(ρ、μ、访问类别、约束预算分数、合取分数)。

title: ToolAnchor: Anchoring Counterfactual Context to Boost Agentic Tool-use Capability
summary: Tool-augmented large language model agents excel at long-horizon tasks, yet they are typically post-trained on fixed toolsets. When tasks demand new tools, these agents struggle to incorporate them effectively, and retraining from scratch is often impractical. We identify the core obstacle in such toolset expansion problem as behavioral inertia: the tendency of agents to fall back on familiar tools and established reasoning patterns despite having access to new ones. We demonstrate that injecting counterfactual anchor contexts at critical decision points can break this inertia, recovering failed trajectories by eliciting suppressed agent capabilities. To scale this insight, we propose ToolAnchor, a framework that uses teacher models to hypothesize these counterfactual contexts, verifies them via student rollouts, and internalizes the successful interventions through agentic post-training. Extensive evaluations across general AI assistant (GAIA), textual search (BrowseComp), and visual search (VDR-Bench) tasks demonstrate that ToolAnchor consistently exhibits competitive performance under expanded toolsets. Our work bridges the gap between static post-training and dynamic adaptation, charting a new path for scalable agentic reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 本文针对工具增强LLM智能体在已训练工具集扩展时面临的"行为惯性"问题（即智能体倾向于沿用旧工具和既有推理模式而忽视新工具），提出了ToolAnchor框架。该框架通过教师模型假设"反事实锚点上下文"（即在关键决策点注入替代的思维-动作对）、学生rollout验证、以及智能体SFT+RL两阶段内化，实现了在不从头重新训练的前提下，使后训练智能体高效适应扩展工具集。在GAIA、BrowseComp和VDR-Bench三个基准上的实验表明，ToolAnchor在保持原有文本任务性能的同时，有效掌握新增的视觉工具使用能力。
AI.motivation: 工具增强LLM智能体通常通过ReAct范式和智能体强化学习在固定工具集上后训练。但当任务需求演变需要引入新工具时（如视觉工具、计算工具等），智能体策略已围绕旧工具集收敛，表现出"行为惯性"——倾向于回退到熟悉的工具和既有推理模式，从而对新工具利用不足，直接使用智能体RL难以有效探索。需要一种方法让已训练智能体在不从头训练的前提下高效扩展工具集。
AI.method: ToolAnchor三阶段框架：(1) **反事实锚点上下文假设**：多样化的教师模型（Gemini-2.5-Pro、GPT-5）审计失败轨迹，根据"下游影响、路径重定向、战略杠杆、反事实潜力"四条准则识别关键锚点轮次，并在仅访问该轮次前历史的前提下生成替代思维-动作对；(2) **反事实锚点上下文验证**：学生智能体从教师锚点上下文恢复生成，采用Pass@3的任务级验证和锚点级LLM-as-a-judge双重验证，仅保留任务成功且锚点确实起作用的上下文；(3) **反事实锚点上下文内化**：先进行锚点专用智能体SFT（损失仅施加于替代思维-动作对上），再进行GRPO智能体RL，实现局部行为与既有策略的协调对齐。学生模型为Qwen3-30B-A3B（Tongyi DeepResearch）。
AI.result: 在三个基准上的主要结果：VDR-Bench（视觉搜索）上达到28.8%，优于Gemini-2.5-Pro (18.8%)、GPT-5 (20.4%)等，但略低于从零训练的Vision-DeepResearch (37.8%，使用5倍数据)；GAIA（通用助手）上达到74.5%，超过基础模型的70.9%以及GPT-5 (67.4%)、Claude-4-Sonnet (68.3%)；BrowseComp（文本搜索）上达到45.0%，相对基础模型43.4%略有提升。消融实验表明：(a) 未经验证的SFT会引入噪声；(b) 仅RL alone难以充分探索；(c) SFT+RL组合最优。验证过滤率：33.67%候选上下文通过任务级验证，31.98%最终保留。锚点轮次主要分布在轨迹前10–20轮。
AI.conclusion: ToolAnchor通过"教师假设-学生验证-策略内化"的循环，将静态后训练与动态适应相结合，为智能体能力扩展提供了一条无需从头训练的实用路径。框架的核心洞见是：工具集扩展不仅是工具选择和推理模式的适配问题，还需要有效的"上下文锚点"来打破既有行为模式。局限性在于教师模型和验证锚点集的有限性，未来可探索更多样化教师与更大规模训练数据以提升泛化能力。

title: Enhancing Small Language Models Reasoning through Knowledge Graph Grounding
comment: Presented at the 2nd Causal Neuro-symbolic Artificial Intelligence (Causal NeSy): Toward Agentic LLMs with Neuro-Symbolic and Graph Based Reasoning Workshop @ ESWC2026
summary: Although large language models (LLMs) have set benchmarks for zero-shot reasoning, their deployment remains cost-prohibitive and environmentally taxing. Small Language Models (SLMs) offer a sustainable alternative, but prone to errors, on tasks requiring complex, multi-hop logical grounding. We investigate a neuro-symbolic agentic framework to enhance the reasoning capabilities of SLMs, specifically Gemma 3 (1B, 4B) and Llama 3.2 (3B), using the CLUTRR kinship benchmark. Our approach transforms the SLM into a minimalist agent utilizing two specialized tool calls: extract_facts for symbolic triplet extraction and get_hint for expert reasoning via a Relational Graph Convolutional Network (RGCN). We evaluate these models across two configurations, both in an Oracle scenario with ground-truth triplets and a Realistic scenario relying on self-extracted knowledge. Our results reveal that while RGCN-derived hints provide a 1.5 - 2x performance gain over story-only baselines, the system is constrained by the extraction bottleneck and sequential deductive fragility, where early extraction errors compound over multi-hop chains. Furthermore, we identify a "distraction effect" in specific architectures where noisy, self-generated facts degrade performance despite the presence of expert hints. This work characterizes the challenges of symbolic grounding in low-resource agentic systems and provides a roadmap for iterative verification in neuro-symbolic agentic pipelines.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种神经-符号智能体框架，通过将小型语言模型（SLM）与关系图卷积网络（RGCN）相结合，在CLUTRR亲属关系推理基准上增强SLM的多跳关系推理能力。框架包含两个工具调用：extract_facts（从故事中提取知识图谱三元组）和get_hint（由RGCN专家提供关系预测）。实验表明该方法在真实场景下能带来1.5-2倍性能提升，但受限于提取瓶颈和顺序演绎脆弱性问题。
AI.motivation: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）在零样本推理方面表现卓越，但其部署成本高昂且对环境负担较大。SLM虽为可持续替代方案，但在需要复杂多跳逻辑推理的任务上容易出错。论文旨在通过神经-符号集成方法弥补SLM在多跳关系推理中的不足。
AI.method: 1. 智能体框架：将SLM（Gemma 3 1B/4B、Llama 3.2 3B）转化为极简智能体；2. 工具调用机制：定义两个工具——extract_facts（通过零样本提示提取亲属关系三元组）和get_hint（由预训练RGCN对知识图谱进行推理，返回关系预测及置信度）；3. 知识图谱构建：采用目标中心表示法（target-centric），并通过后处理加入逆向三元组以确保双向信息流；4. RGCN专家训练：在CLUTRR训练集（k∈{2,3,4}跳）上训练，测试时泛化至10跳；5. 双场景评估：Oracle场景（使用真实三元组）与Realistic场景（使用SLM自提取的事实）。
AI.result: 1. Oracle场景下，Llama 3.2 3B配合Oracle Hint准确率达62.79%（约4倍提升），Gemma 4B在Oracle Facts + Oracle Hint下达74.43%；2. Realistic场景下，RGCN在Oracle事实上的准确率为60.69%，但在SLM提取的事实上骤降至24.88%；3. 整体获得1.5-2倍性能提升（如Gemma 1B从7.5%提升至12.6%）；4. 发现Gemma 4B存在"分心效应"：加入嘈杂的SLM事实（19.75%）反而比仅用GNN Hint（14.98%）效果更差；5. Llama架构在过滤符号噪声方面表现出更强韧性，4跳以上仍保持稳定；6. 观察到"推理悬崖"：真实场景下超过4跳时准确率急剧下降。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了神经-符号智能体系统在零样本关系推理中的关键挑战：SLM具有潜在的复杂关系推理能力，但严重受限于提取瓶颈——早期提取错误会在多跳链中累积，导致准确率崩溃。同时发现的"分心效应"表明，嘈杂的自提取事实可能降低性能，即使存在专家提示。未来工作应聚焦于迭代符号精炼循环以剔除提取幻觉，并针对架构特性进行优化以利用Llama模型的结构韧性。弥合这一提取鸿沟对于开发可靠的因果基础自治系统至关重要。

title: Orchestrating Power Grid Studies with Multi-Agent AI and MCP Servers
summary: This position paper explores how Agentic AI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) can support power-grid studies in a Transmission System Operator (TSO) context. We focus on integrating Large Language Models with numerical simulation tools, structured workflows, and human supervision. We identify key industrial requirements for agent assisted grid studies and introduce pypowsybl-mcp, an MCP-based interface exposing selected capabilities of our simulation tool, pypowsybl to AI agents. This first step provides a testbed to study how agents can setup simulations, execute analyses, retrieve results, and interact with power-system simulators through standardized tool calls. We also discuss principles for human-in-the-loop, multi-agent workflows and outline an evaluation strategy combining technical metrics and practitioner feedback. The paper positions MCP-based tool integration as a step toward more interactive, auditable, and scalable grid-study environments.

AI.tldr: 该立场论文探讨了Agentic AI与模型上下文协议（MCP）如何通过集成大语言模型、数值仿真工具与人工监督，辅助输电系统运营商（TSO）开展电网研究，并提出基于MCP的pypowsybl接口工具。
AI.motivation: 随着电网运行环境的复杂化和研究任务的多样化，传统电网仿真研究依赖专家手动操作工具，难以满足高效、可审计、可扩展的工作需求。作者希望探索如何通过Agentic AI与标准化协议减少人为操作负担，同时保留专家在环（human-in-the-loop）的监督机制。
AI.method: 1）梳理TSO电力系统分析的关键工业需求；2）设计MCP-based接口pypowsybl-mcp，将pypowsybl仿真工具的部分能力以标准化工具调用形式暴露给AI智能体；3）提出智能体负责仿真配置、结果获取与工具调用的工作流；4）提出human-in-the-loop与多智能体协作的设计原则；5）设计结合技术指标与从业者反馈的综合评估策略。
AI.result: 论文发布了pypowsybl-mcp作为测试床原型，使AI智能体能够通过标准化的MCP工具调用完成仿真设置、执行与结果检索；并提出了针对多智能体电网研究环境的评估框架，包含技术度量与从业者主观反馈。
AI.conclusion: 论文将MCP作为电网研究环境走向交互化、可审计和可扩展的关键支撑，认为这是将智能体AI安全集成至TSO日常工作流的重要一步，但仍需后续在生产环境中验证其可靠性与可解释性。

title: MemoHarness: Agent Harnesses That Learn from Experience
summary: An agent harness is the external control layer that turns a base LLM into an executable agent by managing context, tools, orchestration, memory, decoding, and output handling. While harness design strongly affects agent behavior, most automatic improvement methods optimize narrower artifacts such as prompts, pipelines, or workflows, and deployed agents usually reuse a single global harness for all cases. We introduce MemoHarness, an adaptive harness optimization framework that learns from its own executions. MemoHarness decomposes the harness into six editable control dimensions, stores per-case diagnoses and distilled global patterns in a dual-layer experience bank, and adapts the learned harness to each test case using retrieved experience without test-time labels, feedback, or additional search. In our evaluation across shell-agent, code-generation, and analytical-reasoning benchmarks, MemoHarness improves over the fixed harnesses we compare against and shows selective transfer to unseen suites and base models. Its additional context can also remain cost-competitive when much of the retrieved experience is cacheable. These results provide evidence that execution experience is a practical substrate for building agent harnesses that are more adaptive than a single static configuration, while leaving broader claims about statistical robustness and component attribution to future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MemoHarness，一种通过自身执行经验学习并自适应优化的智能体框架（agent harness）优化框架。它将框架按推理时序分解为六个可编辑控制维度（上下文、工具、生成、编排、记忆、输出），利用双层经验库（每案例诊断条目与全局提炼模式）在测试时无需标签或反馈地为每个测试用例定制框架。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型智能体的自动优化方法多聚焦于提示词、流水线或工作流等较窄对象，且部署时通常对所有用例复用同一全局框架，缺乏对每个测试用例的自适应能力。此外，框架维度间高度耦合，仅依靠基准分数（标量奖励）无法定位失败原因并指导后续搜索，导致优化缺乏可解释性与可复用性。
AI.method: 方法由两阶段构成：(1) 训练时搜索阶段，将框架表示为六个时间维度（上下文构建、工具调用、生成控制、编排拓扑、记忆管理、输出处理）的乘积空间 W=∏W^(d)，从最小化框架 W₀ 出发，控制器根据经验库中检索到的相似案例与全局模式提出下一候选配置 W_t，并在标注搜索集上执行获取奖励 r̄_t 与代价 c̄_t；以"正确性优先"的字典序规则选取全局框架 W*（即先比 r̄，再以 -c̄ 作为 tiebreaker）。双层经验库 B=(E,G) 存储每案例执行条目（包含配置差分 Δ、轨迹 τ、奖励 r、代价 c 及诊断算子输出 z=(成功标志、主失败维度、次要维度集合、自然语言分析）），并每隔 N 轮提炼为全局模式。(2) 测试时无反馈适配阶段：对每个无标签测试用例 x=(u,φ)，控制器基于指令嵌入余弦相似度检索 TopK 成功/失败近邻与全局模式，输出针对该用例的框架 W(x) 并执行，无需梯度更新或额外搜索。
AI.result: 在 Terminal-Bench（18 题留出集，基于 GPT-5.3-Codex）上 MemoHarness 达到 0.806，较最强基线 Codex（0.722）提升 +0.084，较其他基线提升 +0.250 至 +0.445。在 LiveCodeBench 与 FinanceAgent 上相对基础框架分别由 0.900→0.967 与 0.600→0.767 提升，长时序分析任务受益最显著。跨数据集迁移至六个外部套件呈"选择性正向迁移"：Terminal-Bench 来源的框架在 MMMLU、StrongReject、SWE-Bench Pro 上分别提升 +0.030、+0.030、+0.059；跨模型迁移（在六个未重训基模型上）平均提升 +0.098，GLM-5 提升最大（+0.233）。成本方面，输入词元 14.18M 中 13.32M 可缓存，使总成本 $6.89 低于 Codex（$10.28）与 Claude Code（$9.51）。操作级诊断显示 cat、sed、which、test 等原子操作与奖励提升显著正相关。
AI.conclusion: 执行经验可作为构建比单一静态配置更自适应的智能体框架的实用载体。MemoHarness 通过结构化的六维控制空间、双层经验库与无反馈测试时适配机制，将框架优化从训练时搜索拓展为搜索-适配两阶段，使经验跨用例与跨模型可复用。未来工作应关注全无监督搜索、规模化验证、更细粒度的组件归因以及跨部署的在线经验累积。当前版本仍存在置信区间缺失、未对所有组件进行消融、成本分析依赖缓存可重用性等局限。

title: When a Verified World Model Still Loses: Play-Adequacy vs Prediction-Accuracy in LLM-Synthesized Code World Models
comment: 41 pages, 4 figures. Code and reproduction log: this https URL
summary: Large language models can synthesize a game's rules as executable code - a Code World Model (CWM) - which a classical planner then searches over. Such models are typically accepted when they reach high transition accuracy on sampled trajectories. We argue this is the wrong notion of adequacy for planning. We show four things. (1) An LLM-synthesized CWM can pass a sampling gate at 100% transition accuracy and be $\geq 98\%$ state-accurate on the planner's own search distribution, yet lose systematically at play, because the $<1\%$ it gets wrong is exactly the pivotal dynamics; the play cost of the omitted rule is $0.091$ (seed-clustered 95% CI $[0.065,0.117]$, $n=4800$). We call this the verified-vs-correct gap, and confirm it end-to-end through the synthesis pipeline. (2) The harm follows a quantitative law, $\mathrm{danger}=\mathrm{play\_cost}\times(1-\mathrm{rarity})^N$, whose $(1-\mathrm{rarity})^N$ gate-miss factor is proven exact and whose play cost is empirically bounded. (3) The failure is not repaired by more data: LLM synthesis behaves as rule translation, not rule inference, and did not infer the omitted rule across models (GPT-5.x) and data regimes (including DAgger and targeted examples). (4) The same mechanism recurs on the belief-inference function of imperfect-information CWMs: we prove a coverage bound (a size-$N$ gate is identifying when $N\gtrsim b^{d_{\max}}$), explaining why shallow games such as Kuhn poker show no gap, and hand-construct Beacon, a verified-but-wrong inference function that passes the gate yet loses every game. These results suggest adequacy for planning-oriented world models should be measured on the search distribution or by play directly, not by prediction accuracy on sampled transitions.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了LLM合成的代码世界模型(CWM)在采样验证中存在一个关键缺陷：即使模型在随机轨迹上达到100%转移准确率且在规划器的搜索分布上保持≥98%状态准确率，仍可能在实际博弈中系统性失败。作者将此称为"验证正确但实际错误"的差距(verified-vs-correct gap)，并提出了一个定量化法则 danger = play_cost × (1−rarity)^N 来刻画采样验证何时会失明。该研究在完全信息和不完全信息博弈两个层面上都验证了这一机制的存在。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM合成代码世界模型(CWM)的范式中，通常采用在随机采样轨迹上检验转移准确率作为"门控"(gate)标准来接受或拒绝合成的世界模型。然而，规划器(如MCTS)的搜索分布与均匀随机的验证分布存在系统性偏差——规划器会将搜索集中在战略意义重大的状态上。本文的核心问题是：通过随机轨迹门控是否足以证明CWM对规划是充分的(play-adequacy)？这本质上是模型预测准确性与下游决策性能之间的目标错位问题，在基于模型的强化学习和程序合成领域都具有根本重要性。
AI.method: 研究方法包括：(1)在三种游戏族(井字棋、Connect Four、army5x5a等)和两种知识条件下测量状态一致差距；(2)通过在army5x5a基础上增加material-at-cap平局规则(随机触发率2.5%，但影响约50%的规划博弈)构建稀有但关键规则的实验装置；(3)用UCT-MCTS进行完全信息博弈规划，用确定化MCTS进行不完全信息博弈规划；(4)提出并验证danger定律 danger = κ·(1−r)^N，其中r是稀有度，N是门控大小；(5)在GPT-5.x家族以及Qwen3-Coder-30B和Claude Sonnet上系统测试多种修复数据机制(naive DAgger、proper DAgger、针对性示例、人工构造状态)；(6)构造Beacon博弈作为不完全信息差距的最小反例，并用掩码井字棋验证转移门控对信念模型的结构性盲视。
AI.result: 主要结果有六项：(1)在army5x5a+material-at-cap上，规则盲CWM通过门控(转移准确率1.0，状态准确率≥98%)，但实际博弈胜率仅0.404 [0.384, 0.424]，与公平基线0.495 [0.475, 0.515]存在0.091的统计学分离差距(n=4800，种子聚类CI [0.065, 0.117])；(2)danger定律在阈值行为上得到验证——稀有度从公共降到极稀有时，伤害从近零上升到饱和于完整play_cost；(3)LLM合成表现为规则翻译而非规则推断：即使提供54个真实在流形上的判别性转换，规则仍未被学会；人工离线流形数据反而破坏合成；(4)覆盖界证明：推理门控在N ≳ b^d_max时是识别的，解释了Kuhn扑克为何无差距；(5)Beacon博弈：一个验证通过(0/8156不匹配)但每局必败(0.000 vs 0.500)的反例，play_cost精确为1/2；(6)信念-转移正交性命题：信息划分不出现在任何(s,a,s',u)元组中，因此转移门控对错误信念模型结构性失明(掩码井字棋：转移门控1.000但观察率0.020)。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心结论是：基于随机采样轨迹的预测准确率是面向规划的LLM世界模型的错误充分性准则。规划充分性应当在搜索分布或直接通过博弈表现来度量，而非通过采样转换的预测准确率。失败源于验证分布(均匀随机)与部署分布(规划器)的到达分布偏移——危险事件在部署-到达路径上但在验证-到达路径之外。该研究提出两个具体实践建议：(1)在规划访问的分布上进行验证或直接测量博弈表现；(2)在合成之前确保规范(specification)的完整性——LLM会翻译给定的规则，但不会从示例中推断遗漏的规则，示例喂入不能替代完整规范。底层的结构性诊断与博弈论中"非均衡路径信念不受约束"的现象同构，采样门控缺少类似序贯均衡那样的精炼机制来约束非路径区域。

title: ReasFlow: Assisting Reasoning-Centric Scientific Discovery in Applied Mathematics via a Knowledge-Based Multi-Agent System
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models have fueled autonomous AI agents capable of tackling complex scientific tasks, yet existing automated research systems remain predominantly focused on empirically driven domains with quantitative benchmarks, leaving theory-driven discovery, particularly in mathematically grounded disciplines requiring rigorous proofs and synthesis of domain knowledge, largely underexplored. Key challenges include the difficulty of verifying theoretical reasoning at scale, insufficient reasoning ability for autonomous frontier exploration, and a scarcity of procedural heuristics in the literature. We introduce ReasFlow, an end-to-end autonomous agent system for reasoning-centric scientific discovery that operationalizes a collaborative paradigm where the human expert acts as Principal Investigator while the agent executes rigorous derivations as a capable graduate student. ReasFlow incorporates (i) a robust internal verification loop that audits logical coherence and corrects fundamental errors prior to human inspection, and (ii) an automated knowledge retrieval and self-improvement mechanism that proactively surfaces both declarative facts and overlooked procedural heuristics, substantially reducing expert intervention. The system unifies literature synthesis, algorithm design, theorem proving, experimentation, and manuscript preparation in a single system. Deployed to autonomously generate five complete research papers with rigorous theoretical and empirical content from minimal prompts, ReasFlow consistently achieves the highest evaluation scores among state-of-the-art open-access baselines under a curated LLM-based review rubric. ReasFlow is publicly accessible via the ReasLab platform, providing a collaborative workspace for AI-assisted theoretical research. Github repo: this https URL .

AI.tldr: ReasFlow 是一个端到端的自主智能体系统，专门面向以推理为核心的科学发现（特别是需要严格数学证明的理论学科），将文献综合、算法设计、定理证明、实验验证和论文撰写整合于单一流程，并通过内部验证循环与自动化知识检索机制显著降低对人类专家的依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化科研系统多聚焦于以经验数据和量化基准为主的领域，而对以理论推理与严格证明为驱动的数学基础学科（如算法理论、计算复杂性等）涉足甚少。其核心障碍包括：大规模理论推理难以自动验证、LLM 在自主前沿探索中的推理能力不足、以及文献中程序性启发式知识的稀缺。作者旨在填补这一空白，让 AI 代理能够独立完成"理论驱动型"科研任务。
AI.method: ReasFlow 采用"人机协作 PI-研究生"范式，将人类专家定位为首席研究员（PI），AI 代理作为执行严格推导的研究生。具体包含两大关键模块：(1) 内部验证循环——审计逻辑一致性并在人类审查前修正基础性错误；(2) 自动化知识检索与自我改进机制——主动提取声明性事实与被忽视的程序性启发式知识，从而减少专家介入。系统整合了文献综合、算法设计、定理证明、实验验证和论文撰写等多个环节，并以"最小提示"启动全流程自主运行。
AI.result: ReasFlow 被部署用于从极简提示出发自主生成五篇完整的研究论文（含严格理论与实证内容）。在基于大语言模型评审框架的评测下，ReasFlow 在所有可访问的开放基线方法中均取得最高评分，验证了其在理论与实证双重层面的科研产出质量。同时，该系统已开源并部署在 ReasLab 协作平台上供研究社区使用。
AI.conclusion: ReasFlow 证明了 LLM 驱动的自主智能体能够胜任以严密理论推导为核心的科学发现任务，标志着自动化科研从"经验驱动"向"理论驱动"的拓展。其人机协作范式与内建的自检、检索机制有效缓解了理论验证难、推理能力不足和启发式知识稀缺三大瓶颈，为 AI 辅助理论研究的协作工作空间树立了新范式。

title: RxBrain: Embodied Cognition Foundation Model with Joint Language-Visual Reasoning and Imagination
summary: Embodied cognition requires agents to connect high-level task reasoning with the physical states to be achieved. We introduce Hy-Embodied-RxBrain, an embodied cognition foundation model with joint language-visual reasoning and imagination. Unlike vision-language models that emphasize scene understanding and textual decision making, or generative world models that mainly predict future visual states, RxBrain represents embodied plans in a single planning sequence where language and visual imagination play complementary roles. Language provides the abstract structure of a plan, including task decomposition, planning primitives, constraints, temporal order, and decision logic, while visual imagination grounds this structure through world state prediction and joint subgoal planning, associating each planning step with intermediate and final physical states. RxBrain adopts a unified multimodal Mixture-of-Transformers architecture that supports language, image, and video understanding and generation within one model. To train this capability, we build an automatic pipeline that converts embodied videos into joint text-visual planning supervision by decomposing videos into planning steps and aligning them with visual state transitions. We further introduce RxBrain-Bench to evaluate whether models can represent embodied plans through joint textual and visual components rather than separate understanding or generation. Experiments show that RxBrain maintains embodied understanding and generation abilities, and produces plans with coupled textual reasoning, world state prediction, and joint subgoal planning. We also extend RxBrain to continuous robot action generation, where it shows promising real-robot performance without large-scale action-data pretraining. These results provide an initial step toward foundation models for embodied cognition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hy-Embodied-RxBrain，一种具有联合语言-视觉推理与想象的具身认知基础模型，通过统一的Mixture-of-Transformers架构，将语言规划抽象结构与视觉想象的世界状态预测相结合，实现单一规划序列内的多模态协同推理与生成。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型（VLM）侧重场景理解与文本决策，而生成式世界模型主要预测未来视觉状态，二者均未将高层任务推理与物理状态达成在单一规划序列中耦合表达。论文旨在解决具身认知中语言抽象规划与视觉状态预测割裂的问题，填补具身基础模型的空白。
AI.method: 1) 提出RxBrain模型，采用统一多模态Mixture-of-Transformers架构，支持语言、图像、视频的理解与生成；2) 设计联合文本-视觉规划表示，语言提供任务分解、规划原语、约束、时序与决策逻辑，视觉想象提供世界状态预测与子目标规划；3) 构建自动数据处理管线，将具身视频分解为规划步骤并与视觉状态转换对齐，生成联合监督；4) 提出评估基准RxBrain-Bench，专门评测联合文本-视觉规划能力。
AI.result: 实验表明RxBrain在保持具身理解与生成能力的同时，能够生成耦合文本推理、世界状态预测与联合子目标规划的规划方案；此外，在无需大规模动作数据预训练的情况下，扩展至连续机器人动作生成时，在真实机器人上表现出有前景的性能。
AI.conclusion: RxBrain为具身认知基础模型迈出了初步一步，验证了语言与视觉想象在同一规划序列中互补融合的可行性，为构建具备真正具身认知能力的基础模型提供了新的技术路径与评估基准。

title: How Artificial Intelligence LLM Engines Shape the Global Conflict Information Environment
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) answer engines now field a growing share of the questions that analysts, scholars, and the public ask about issues of peace and conflict. Large Language Models (LLMs) are known to hallucinate under certain conditions, but do these errors have discernible patterns when they are asked about conflicts, and if so what can that teach us about the changing global conflict information environment? To answer, we first asked a battery of questions about 28 conflicts to five leading answer engines and scored their 5,460 answers against documented evidence. We found that the thinner the retrievable record around a given conflict, the more the engines invent, misattribute, and miscount. Thin records don't just encourage hallucination, but create structural exposure to mis- and disinformation, because they are the easiest records to warp through Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) to bias engine responses. Through an analysis of 1,048 websites that the AI LLMs pulled conflict facts from, we found that GEO source optimization is already happening, and while state-partisan digital capture remains incipient it is rapidly growing. We explain what these findings mean for scholarship with the rise of GEO information warfare, and for policy argue for a return to the deep local monitoring and translation-based research that AI tools cannot replicate, closing with a discussion of future research opportunities and challenges in this fast-moving space.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，当AI回答引擎被询问关于国际冲突的问题时，冲突相关可检索信息越稀薄，引擎越容易产生幻觉（虚构、错误归因、计数错误）；同时，生成式引擎优化（GEO）正在被用来操纵AI的冲突信息来源，导致结构性的错误和虚假信息暴露风险。
AI.motivation: 随着AI回答引擎越来越多地承担公众、学者和分析师获取冲突信息的职能，研究者希望探究LLM在回答冲突相关问题时是否存在系统性的错误模式，以及这些模式能否揭示全球冲突信息环境的变化，特别是应对生成式引擎优化（GEO）和信息战带来的新兴威胁。
AI.method: 研究方法包括：(1) 向五款主流AI回答引擎就28个冲突提出大量问题，共收集5,460个答案，并对照已记录证据进行评分；(2) 分析AI从中提取冲突事实的1,048个网站，研究GEO源优化（即针对AI引擎的内容操纵）的现状和发展趋势；(3) 综合评估薄记录冲突（thin records）对AI错误率和可操纵性的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现：(1) 冲突的可检索记录越稀薄，AI引擎的虚构、错误归因和错误计数问题越严重；(2) GEO源优化（即针对AI引擎的内容操纵）已经在发生，针对AI引擎的内容策略正在被部署；(3) 国家党派性的数字捕获（state-partisan digital capture）虽然仍处于初期，但增长迅速；(4) 薄记录冲突不仅鼓励幻觉，还为错误信息和虚假信息提供了结构性敞口，因为这些记录最容易通过GEO进行扭曲。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论指出，AI工具无法替代深度的本地监测和基于翻译的研究工作；面对GEO信息战的兴起，学术界和政策制定者需要回归到AI难以复制的深度本地化、翻译型研究方法；论文最后讨论了在这一快速变化领域中未来研究的机会与挑战，呼吁学界关注AI时代冲突信息生态的结构性脆弱性。

title: Align AI to Dynamic Human-AI Workflows
summary: Current alignment approaches typically focus on emulating human behavior using static representations of human preferences, failing to capture the dynamic, context-dependent nature of real-world human-AI interactions. In this paper, we argue for a shift from static and emulative to interactive and complementary alignment, where preferences emerge through interaction and alignment is defined not by satisfying preferences alone. We first formalize this gap by contrasting existing alignment with a trajectory-level view in which human and model behavior co-evolve over time. Because these interaction dynamics have not been adequately captured within existing ML formulations, we ground this perspective in insights from an interdisciplinary workshop. We draw on lessons from social-science accounts of human-human collaboration and then argue that human-AI systems amplify these dynamics, introducing new asymmetries that make reasoning about uncertainty harder and introduce new coordination challenges. Based on these lessons and new challenges, we conclude by outlining a research agenda for developing AI systems that align with humans in interaction, requiring an interdisciplinary synthesis of machine learning and the social and decision sciences.

AI.tldr: 本文主张AI对齐应从静态模拟人类偏好的范式转向动态交互的互补对齐范式，强调人机协作中偏好随交互共同演化，呼吁跨学科（机器学习与社会科学、决策科学）研究来应对人机工作流中的新挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有AI对齐方法（如RLHF、偏好优化、行为克隆等）主要基于静态人类偏好来模拟人类行为，无法捕捉真实人机交互中动态、上下文依赖的特性。随着智能体AI系统越来越多地融入人类工作流并在世界中采取行动，这种以快照式评估和优化为主的范式存在根本性缺陷。
AI.method: 1. 形式化对比：将现有"静态-模拟式对齐"与"轨迹级（trajectory-level）"对齐视角进行对比，强调人机行为随时间共同演化。2. 跨学科研讨会：基于机器学习与社会科学跨学科研讨会的洞察进行综合分析。3. 借鉴与扩展：先借鉴社会科学中关于人-人协作（信任、互补性）的理论，再论证人机协作如何在新的条件下放大这些动态（能力与信息的不对称、缺乏社会制度线索、新角色）。4. 提出研究议程：勾勒出在交互中对齐AI系统的概念、转化和评估挑战。
AI.result: 论文核心结论/主张是：需要将对齐目标从"优化快照式模型性能"转向"优化人机系统随时间演化的轨迹"。具体地：1）偏好应在交互中涌现，而非预先静态给定；2）AI应与人类互补，而非仅仅模仿人类；3）人机系统引入了新的不对称性（使不确定性推理更难）和新的协调挑战；4）需要机器学习与社会科学、决策科学的跨学科综合。论文以AI编码助手为例展示了用户信任和依赖随交互历史动态变化的过程。
AI.conclusion: 本文呼吁AI对齐研究社区从静态模拟范式转向动态互补范式，提出需要在轨迹层面优化人机系统的行为，并对人机工作流中的对齐提出了基础性考量与开放问题，为未来跨学科研究指明方向。

title: The Steering Budget: Examples beat Knobs
summary: Generative models are steered with knobs -- prompts, guidance scales, property tags. Turn one as hard as you like and, past a point, it stops moving the property you care about. We find that ceiling is not a shortcoming of the model but a budget, set by the training data before the model is trained: a property's movable range splits in two -- the part a knob can reach, and a second, significant part that only examples -- concrete instances of what you want more of -- can reach. That second part is usually much larger, but not always, and the same budget says so in advance. Reaching that second part takes a different move: instead of turning a knob, you show the model examples, composed from what it already learned rather than added to its training. A cheap audit of the training data measures the budget; we give a recipe for building the example set that reaches all of it. This buys two things a knob can't. Reach: it moves a property across the whole budget, not just the part a knob reaches. Expressiveness: it steers toward targets you can only specify by example -- including ones you can't put into words. We turn these into a handful of falsifiable claims and verify them in two unrelated domains, image and crystal-structure generation -- marking where a knob is enough, and where only examples will do.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"转向预算"(steering budget)框架,将生成模型的属性可调范围精确划分为两部分:组内方差(T,可通过提示词/引导强度等"告知式"旋钮触及)与组间方差(E,仅能通过示例集"展示式"控制触及)。该预算可仅从训练数据中预先计算,在图像(ImageNet/DiT)与晶体结构生成两个不相关领域上均得到验证,证明示例通常比旋钮走得更远,且预算本身就能预测何时旋钮足够、何时只有示例可行。
AI.motivation: 生成模型转向存在明显天花板——调大提示词或引导尺度,目标属性推到位后再用力也无济于事。论文质疑该上限是否真为模型缺陷,主张它实质上是训练数据预先设定的"预算";揭示为何某些目标根本不能由旋钮到达,并给出可量化、可预测的替代方案(展示示例),以打通旋钮到不了的那部分空间,同时解释模式坍缩、对齐税、奖励作弊、组合泛化失败等熟知的对齐/生成痛点为何共享同一机制。
AI.method: 核心方法:(1)定义"廉价键"π将输出分入B个组(bin),"昂贵属性"L=ψ(D);(2)由全方差定律将Var_𝒥(L)精确分解为组内预算T=Σw_b v_b(告知可达)与组间预算E=Σw_b(g_b-ḡ)²(展示可达);(3)由Cauchy–Schwarz推导两种操作的到达上界|ΔE[L]|≤√(χ²·budget),其中χ²为Pearson散度,衡量重加权强度;(4)给出最小χ²闭合形式配方μ_P;(5)在两域验证四个可证伪命题——DiT-XL/2-256(ImageNet,ResNet-50为键)与晶体生成器(键为元素+原子数),用95%自助置信区间、预设预注册、显式χ²诊断(漂移δ、展宽比ρ)。
AI.result: 四个核心结论均经两域验证:(1)预算分解精确且随分箱粒度移动,在模型上对被忠实再现的属性成立——晶体密度相关性0.985、键合0.879、稳定性仅0.488(预测与实测排序一致);(2)展示示例比最强旋钮强数倍——晶体带隙E/√T=6.8,实测展示/旋钮比≈800×(弱标签)/26×(best-of-12最强组内旋钮);图像动物语义比3.0×,但低E/(E+T)目标(亮度、美学)反而被强旋钮反超(通过"离开原bin"实现);(3)目标曲率决定配方形状——平均类目标(动物-自然联合67%由单一最富bin达成)需集中,覆盖类目标(车辆-食物清洁覆盖0.30、晶体带隙-介电常数Pareto覆盖0.40)仅能由混合达成,告知皆为0;(4)训练可预测改变预算——过滤与引导扫描实测与预测一致,过度微调(创新性微调将真实结构打分降至低于随机)则需回退至模型直接审计。
AI.conclusion: 论文把"调生成模型"这件事从经验技巧提升为可由数据预算先验预测的科学:告知式旋钮结构上被困在组内预算T内,展示式示例则触及组间预算E;E/(E+T)即"展示优势指数",在训练前就可读出,从而回答"何时需要示例、何时旋钮已足"。该框架统一解释了模式坍缩、对齐税、奖励作弊、组合泛化失败——四者皆是"按样本计分的奖励/微调目标"用尽组间预算却无法恢复的同一机制。未来工作指向分布级训练目标、表示-损失残差预测属性可携带性、无监督发现能暴露隐性偏好的键。

title: Automatic Hard Example Synthesis with Multi-Level Agentic Data Curation
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed for nuanced content safety and moderation tasks, yet they remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks and out-of-distribution edge cases. Traditional active learning and manual annotation fail to scale against the complexity and volume of novel multimodal threats. In this paper, we propose an automated, agentic red-teaming framework that systematically synthesizes difficult examples using an iterative strategy that proposes novel hypotheses as well as mutating on past attempts. Leveraging a multi-agent architecture that consists of a high-reasoning Architect agent, an advanced image generator, and a multi-level verification committee of LLM raters, our system autonomously uncovers boundary-pushing violations and ambiguous policy edge cases without any human intervention. By employing these carefully synthesized adversarial examples as in-context demonstrations via test-time Retrieval, we substantially improve the target model's robustness, reducing the False Negative Rate (FNR) from 41.2% to 24.5% in a public image safety benchmark without relying on any human labeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于多模态内容安全分类的自动化多智能体红队框架，通过"架构师-操作员-评审委员会"三级多智能体架构自主挖掘策略边界处的困难样本，并结合测试时检索增强（RAG）实现上下文学习，将HoliSafe-Bench基准上的误漏检率（FNR）从41.2%降至24.5%，全程无需人工标注。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）被广泛部署于内容安全与广告合规等高风险任务，但其面对对抗性攻击和分布外边界案例时仍显脆弱。传统主动学习与人工标注在面对海量新型多模态威胁时难以扩展，导致已标注语料对"未知未知"区域（unknown unknowns）覆盖不足，平台持续暴露于新兴威胁之下。论文旨在解决如何在无需人类专家参与的前提下，规模化地自动挖掘并利用决策边界附近的困难样本以增强模型鲁棒性。
AI.method:
1. 多智能体架构（基于Gemini 3系列骨干）：
   - **架构师智能体（Architect）**：基于策略文本与持久记忆库，通过"探索-变异"范式（75%全新假设 + 25%对成功父假设的变异）生成漏洞假设、图像生成提示与文字叠加方案；
   - **操作员智能体（Operator）**：Nano Banana Pro，将提示转化为合成图像；
   - **一级评审委员会（CR₁）**：3个Gemini 3 Flash实例独立投票，检测目标模型错误或内部分歧；
   - **二级陪审团（CR₂）**：3个Gemini 3.1 Pro实例，在一级委员会经辩论后仍僵持时介入仲裁。
2. 奖励加权进化策略：模糊样本奖励=1.0，目标错误样本=0.7，无分歧=0，用于引导变异采样。
3. 验证-辩论-陪审三段式协议：检测目标模型预测与外部共识的偏离，自动累积400张困难/常规样本池。
4. 测试时检索增强（k=4的Few-Shot ICL）：通过余弦相似度动态检索最相关困难样本作为上下文演示。
AI.result: 在HoliSafe-Bench公共基准上，使用Gemini 3 Flash作为目标分类器，Gemini 3系列管道+困难样本池+详细策略提示的组合将FNR从零样本基线的0.412降至0.245（95%置信区间完全不重叠，统计显著），准确率从0.589提升至0.745，F1从0.731提升至0.849。在专有广告安全数据集上同样观察到一致改进。消融研究表明：① 困难样本池持续优于常规合成样本；② Gemini 3骨干显著优于Gemini 2.5（后者在该任务上仅勉强超越零样本基线）；③ k=4为最优上下文长度；④ 75%探索/25%变异为最优新假设与变异比例；⑤ 随机选择基线明显劣于基于嵌入的动态检索，证明增益来源于语义相关的困难样本而非通用少样本效应。
AI.conclusion: 论文验证了多智能体红队框架在大规模、无人工标注条件下自动挖掘多模态安全漏洞的可行性与有效性，证明了"明确策略定义 + 困难样本动态检索"可显著校准决策边界并降低漏检率。局限包括：对前沿模型推理能力的高度依赖、合成与真实媒介之间的领域差距、检索带来的推理时延迟、以及在降低FNR时可能轻微牺牲精度。未来工作将探索智能体评审员的规模化、奖励结构的精细化，以及将困难样本蒸馏至更紧凑的学生模型中。

title: AI Agents Do Not Fail Alone:The Context Fails First
summary: Context engineering has become central to building reliable AI agents, yet it remains largely unmeasured. Agents do not fail in isolation: their behavior is shaped by the instructions, tools, memory, retrieved knowledge, guardrails, and untrusted inputs accumulated in their context. When this context is weak, agents drift, hallucinate, misuse tools, ignore constraints, become vulnerable to injection, and waste tokens. This paper validates context-engineering quality as an independent leading indicator of agent reliability. We implement the measurement in ProofAgent-Harness, an open-source infrastructure for AI agent evaluation that uses multi-juror, consensus-based scoring. The harness assesses context across seven criteria: role clarity, guardrail coverage, instruction consistency, tool schema quality, grounding sufficiency, injection hardening, and token efficiency. Crucially, the context score is isolated from behavioral metrics and release decisions, enabling a non-circular validation. Through a controlled context-quality study across regulated agent domains, holding frontier LLM agents fixed and varying only their operating context, we show that context-quality criteria consistently predict their corresponding behavioral outcomes. Grounding sufficiency predicts hallucination resistance, guardrail coverage predicts manipulation resistance, instruction consistency predicts instruction following, and tool-schema quality predicts tool use. These findings establish context measurement as a validated preflight signal for agent reliability and position context engineering as an auditable layer of agent evaluation and governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将"上下文工程质量"作为AI智能体可靠性的独立前置指标，通过ProofAgent-Harness开源框架从七个维度（角色清晰度、护栏覆盖、指令一致性、工具模式质量、接地充分性、注入加固、令牌效率）对智能体上下文进行独立于行为评分的共识打分，并通过固定模型、仅改变上下文的对照实验证明上下文质量可预测下游行为结果。
AI.motivation: 随着AI智能体从单轮助手演变为多步工具调用系统，上下文（指令、工具定义、检索知识、记忆、护栏、不可信输入）成为隐藏的可靠性层。然而该层长期缺乏独立测量：团队通常在事后通过行为评估发现失败，却无法追溯失败根源是接地不足、角色模糊、指令冲突、工具模式不完善还是护栏缺失。这构成了操作性盲区——也使得上下文工程沦为依赖直觉的提示词调优，而非可审计的工程实践。
AI.method: 1) 将上下文工程质量形式化为七准则可测构造：角色清晰度、护栏覆盖、指令一致性、工具模式质量、接地充分性、注入加固、令牌效率，每项得分区间[0,10]，并通过加权聚合为总体上下文评分与等级标签（Strong/Adequate/Weak）；2) 在ProofAgent-Harness中实现多评审员共识打分机制（median聚合、辩论重投或Delphi式），产出证据关联的诊断结果；3) 关键设计原则是隔离——上下文评分不进入行为评分、最终成绩或发布决策，从而支持非循环验证；4) 在三个受监管领域（客户支持、医疗理赔分诊、法律合同起草）开展对照实验，固定前沿LLM骨干（GPT-5.5与Claude Opus 4.8），仅改变上下文（C1 Poor、C2 Structured、C3 Hardened），共300次多轮评估、7500个评估回合；5) 补充工件研究验证上下文质量对生成交付物的预测力。
AI.result: 结构化（C1→C2）带来最大行为收益：最终评分3.15→5.49、幻觉抵抗3.21→5.61、工具使用3.46→6.25、关键失败4.11→1.33；加固（C2→C3）继续提升上下文质量（8.08→8.68）但轻微降低某些行为指标（5.49→5.16），揭示了"更保守规则不单调改善所有指标"的工程权衡；上下文评分正确区分三档条件（4.4→8.1→8.7）；核心预测关系均显著且方向正确：接地充分性→幻觉抵抗r=0.63，护栏覆盖→操纵抵抗r=0.60，指令一致性→指令遵循r=0.57，工具模式质量→工具使用r=0.47；工件研究证实接地上下文使生成运行手册的幻觉抵抗从2.0提升至10.0；最弱上下文反而单次调用成本最低（392个开销令牌），验证"弱上下文的代价由可靠性而非令牌承担"。
AI.conclusion: 上下文工程质量可作为AI智能体可靠性的独立、可审计、可复现的前置信号，充当行为评估前的预检诊断而非替代品。该工作将上下文工程从直觉驱动的提示词实践重构为智能体评估与治理中的可度量层级，支持团队在多轮对抗性测试前快速定位操作环境的薄弱环节——结构（角色、工具、接地、指令组织）是最大可靠性杠杆，加固（护栏、注入分离、确认机制）则通过再平衡行为体现价值，令牌效率应解读为每令牌可靠性价值而非上下文最短化。

title: Measuring How Students Rely on Generative AI in Academic Writing: Development and Multi-Source Validation of the Generative AI Reliance Types Scale (GenAI-RTS)
summary: As generative AI (GenAI) becomes increasingly embedded in undergraduate academic writing, how students rely on these tools, rather than simply whether they use them, has become a central question for learning, academic integrity, and educational equity. Existing measures of reliance were developed inductively, focused on discrete problem-solving tasks, and validated mainly with homogeneous samples. This study developed and validated the GenAI Reliance Types Scale (GenAI-RTS), a 20-item instrument measuring four theoretically derived types of GenAI reliance: Strategic, Instrumental, Dependent, and Dialogic. Validation followed the multisource framework of the Standards for Educational and Psychological Testing, drawing on a survey of 382 undergraduates at a U.S. Minority-Serving Institution and interviews with 14 purposively sampled students. Confirmatory factor analyses of six competing models supported a five-factor structure in which Strategic Reliance comprises two facets, Deliberate Use and Critical Evaluation, alongside Instrumental, Dependent, and Dialogic factors (CFI = .92, RMSEA = .08; DWLS CFI = .98, RMSEA = .07). Subscale reliability was acceptable to good (omega = .75-.88), and scalar measurement invariance held across gender, first-generation status, and STEM/non-STEM majors, to our knowledge the first such evidence for a GenAI reliance instrument. Rasch analysis indicated that a five-point response format would improve category functioning. Strategic reliance was positively associated with AI literacy, and the reliance types differentiated students across multiple writing process and outcome variables. The GenAI-RTS offers researchers and educators a theoretically grounded, psychometrically validated instrument for identifying undergraduate reliance profiles and supporting research, assessment, and AI literacy intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文开发并验证了Generative AI Reliance Types Scale (GenAI-RTS)，一个20项的自评量表，用于测量本科生在学术写作中对生成式AI的四种依赖类型（策略性、工具性、依赖性、对话性）。研究基于美国一所少数族裔服务机构的382名本科生调查和14名深度访谈，采用《教育与心理测试标准》的多源验证框架，通过六种竞争模型的验证性因素分析、测量不变性检验和Rasch分析，证实了五因素结构（策略性依赖包含两个层面：审慎使用与批判评估），并支持标量测量不变性。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI（如ChatGPT）在本科生学术写作中使用率接近普遍（英国本科生使用率从2024年的66%升至2026年的95%），"是否使用"的问题已失去诊断价值。教育、学习完整性和教育公平领域亟需关注的核心问题是"如何依赖"——即区分批判性评估并选择性整合AI内容的学生与不加评估就接受并提交的学生。现有依赖测量存在三个关键缺口：(1)多基于离散决策任务而非扩展性学术写作情境；(2)主要采用归纳法而非理论驱动；(3)缺乏跨人口群体的标量测量不变性证据，无法支持有意义的群体比较。
AI.method: 研究采用顺序解释性混合方法设计，以《教育与心理测试标准》(AERA等, 2014)的论证式验证框架为指导，整合定量与定性证据来源：(1)从元认知理论、批判性AI素养和写作研究三大文献体系中演绎推导四种依赖类型的分类法；(2)通过25项初始题项的演绎生成和三位教师专家评审确定20项终稿；(3)对382名本科生（来自无种族多数的少数族裔服务机构）实施问卷调查；(4)通过六种竞争测量模型（1-5因素及高阶模型）的验证性因素分析比较结构效度；(5)进行Cronbach α、McDonald ω信度分析以及AVE、CR、HTMT聚合/区分效度检验；(6)跨性别、是否第一代大学生、STEM/非STEM专业进行构形—度量—标量测量不变性检验；(7)对各层面进行Rasch评定量表分析评估反应格式功能；(8)对14名最大差异抽样受访者进行定向内容分析提供反应过程证据；(9)将依赖类型与AI素养、写作过程及结果变量进行先验关联检验。
AI.result: 研究结果支持以下结论：(1)五层面模型（M5）在ML和DWLS两种估计方法下均优于五个竞争模型（ML下CFI=.916, RMSEA=.079；DWLS下CFI=.976, RMSEA=.066），AIC和BIC最低；策略性依赖需分离为审慎使用和批判评估两个层面；(2)层面信度可接受至良好（ω=.75-.88），AVE多数超过.50，CR均超过.70；(3)首次为GenAI依赖测量工具提供跨性别、第一代大学生身份和STEM/非STEM专业的标量测量不变性证据（ΔCFI≤.002, ΔRMSEA≤.015）；(4)Rasch分析揭示7点反应格式存在功能失调——"略不同意"类别（类别3）出现阈值紊乱，建议修订为5点格式；(5)19/20项载荷≥.66（仅DEL3项载荷为.25）；(6)策略性依赖与AI素养正相关（r=.51-.61），批判评估与依赖性依赖几乎正交（r=-.07）；(7)四种主导依赖类型在所有10项写作过程和结果变量上差异显著（η²=.166-.329）；(8)反应过程分析发现依赖性依赖可能被自评低估（受访者仅以过去时态描述），且相似的审慎使用得分可能源于不同动机；(9)工具性与对话性依赖虽高度相关（r=.77），但在原创性（d=0.45）和批判性思维（d=0.41）上仍有区分。研究亦明确标识了三项解释边界。
AI.conclusion: GenAI-RTS是首个理论驱动的、经确认性测试的学术写作中GenAI依赖类型分类工具，提供了《标准》框架下四类有效性证据（测试内容、反应过程、内部结构、与其它变量关系）。研究确认了四类型分类法（理论层面）的有效性和五层面测量结构（操作层面）的必要性，并首次为该领域工具建立跨人口群体的标量测量不变性。该量表应作为形成性诊断工具而非学术不端筛查设备使用——得分应解释为依赖特征而非固定学生类型。建议下一版量表对DEL3项进行重新措辞并采用5点反应格式。未来研究需在多机构、不同情境下进行独立样本验证，纳入纵向设计、行为日志数据、外部写作质量评估以及更全面的跨群体测量不变性检验，以建立累积的有效性论证。

title: Tracing LLM Behavior to the Training Data with Empirical Next-Token Distributions
summary: In this paper, we study the connection between an LLM's output distribution and the data used to train it. Specifically, we study the degree to which an LLM's next-token distribution agrees with the empirical next-token distribution (ENTD) given the context in the training data. The ENTD is an appealing target because it is the unrestricted global minimizer of the next-token cross entropy loss used for pretraining, as well as an easily interpretable function of the pretraining corpus. We find that for a significant fraction of inputs, the LLM's distribution agrees with the ENTD almost perfectly, and the average agreement increases with model scale and training compute. Nevertheless, there is a long tail of input sequences where the LLM and ENTD differ significantly, and we examine several possible sources of this discrepancy across the transformer architecture, training procedure, and finite-sample noise in the ENTD estimate itself. More broadly, we hope our findings will encourage more work on ``data-centric mechanistic interpretability,'' a complement to standard mechanistic interpretability that opens the black box of how model behaviors arise from the data, rather than how they are encoded in the learned weights.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了LLM输出分布与训练数据的经验下一token分布（ENTD，即预训练交叉熵损失的全局最优解）之间的吻合程度。基于Pythia模型套件（70M至2.8B参数），发现约20%的输入LLM几乎完美匹配ENTD，且平均吻合度随模型规模和训练算力提升；但仍存在显著的差异长尾。研究排除了batch对齐效应（位置不变性）和softmax瓶颈作为主要差异来源，揭示了优化随机性、Transformer架构的归纳偏置（尤其是对高频高熵输入倾向于生成过于"狭窄"的分布）等因素的影响，并提出了"数据中心机制可解释性"这一新方向。
AI.motivation: 理解LLM能力如何从训练数据中涌现是核心问题。现有研究多通过影响函数或逐点匹配将模型行为追溯到单个数据点，但缺少对数据分布层面与模型行为的系统性定量关联。ENTD作为预训练损失的全局最小化器，是连接数据与模型行为的最直接的数学目标，但LLM在分布层面与ENTD的吻合程度及偏差来源此前未被深入研究。
AI.method: 1. 定义两种参考分布：标准ENTD（全语料统计）和ENTD-T（训练batch对齐位置统计）。2. 使用Pythia模型套件（70M-2.8B参数）及训练过程中的checkpoint，并利用PolyPythias（同架构不同随机种子）分析优化随机性。3. 采用∞-gram（基于后缀数组）高效计算大规模语料的k-gram计数。4. 基于出现频次和长度进行分层采样（避免绝大多数样本只出现一次的偏差）。5. 以总变差距离（TV）作为LLM与ENTD之间差异的主要度量，分析整体分布、按长度/频次/熵的分层分布、TV尾部的具体样本，以及训练过程中单样本TV轨迹的演化。6. 通过训练一个无约束的低秩logit逼近来检验softmax瓶颈的上界。
AI.result: 1. 约20%的分层评估样本中LLM几乎完美匹配ENTD（TV≤0.0093），但仍有80%存在显著差异。2. **强位置不变性**：LLM对batch对齐与否不敏感，不同偏移的ENTD-T与LLM的TV分布几乎一致；通过仅在两个batch上长时间训练验证了这一结果是真实的。3. **softmax瓶颈非主因**：自然文本的经验分布可被远低于d_model秩的低秩logit逼近，远好于LLM自身的拟合，说明Transformer未充分利用低秩结构。4. **优化随机性随规模减弱**：70M模型中模型-ENTD偏差小于模型间偏差；2.8B模型中模型间偏差已小于模型-ENTD偏差。5. **长度分层行为**：短前缀TV分布较集中且较平缓；长前缀呈两极分化——要么几乎完美拟合，要么完全不拟合。6. **ENTD熵与最终TV的高相关性**：在高频样本（count≥10^4）中，ENTD熵与最终TV的Spearman相关系数高达0.80，说明模型对真高熵分布"难以近似"而非仅是"预测不准"，这可能部分解释LLM生成文本的同质化现象。7. **高TV尾部分类**：包括稀有输入（采样噪声）、高频高熵输入（模型过于狭窄化）、高频近确定性模板/垃圾文本（模型拒绝承诺）、及稀有不可预测输入。8. **个体轨迹动态**：小模型TV轨迹更振荡，大模型两端稳定、中间振荡；某些checkpoint出现短暂的下一token分布塌缩现象。
AI.conclusion: LLM与ENTD的吻合程度在平均层面支持经典scaling laws，但在逐样本层面揭示了丰富的异质行为。位置不变性、softmax瓶颈和优化随机性均不是LLM-ENTD偏差的主导来源；真正系统性偏差来源于Transformer架构对高频高熵分布倾向于"收窄"的归纳偏置，以及对确定性模板的"过度泛化"。该研究倡导"数据中心机制可解释性"——通过追溯模型行为到训练数据分布本身而非内部权重，来理解LLM能力的来源。

title: Traccia: An OpenTelemetry-Based Governance Platform for AI Systems
comment: 26 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables, Declaration of generative AI and AI-assisted technologies in the writing process, Declaration of competing interest
summary: The rapid development of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Artificial Intelligent (AI) powered autonomous agents has fundamentally changed the existing forms of software governance. In spite of the rigorous standards of transparency and account ability required according to the international frameworks such as the European Union's AI Act, there is a considerable gap between theory and reality. The present study discusses the inherent drawbacks of currently utilized platforms for LLM evaluation, machine learning workflow, and application performance monitoring in general. It has been shown that current disjointed solutions fail to protect unbound state space agentic architecture from serious threats such as alignment drift, SaaS security concerns, and unauthorized deployment of shadow AI systems. Moreover, a solution is proposed for overcoming the discussed challenges in form of a coherent multi-level AI governance stack Traccia built on the top of OpenTelemetry infrastructure platform. Traccia resolves the last mile for AI Alignment by adding the telemetry data, passive semantic guardrail assessment, and execution lineage into a hashed trace ledger. Traccia automatically creates compliance evidence packages by appending tamper-resistant fingerprints and SHA-256 content hash, that map to regulatory requirements (Articles 12, 14, 19, 26(6), and 50 of the EU AI Act) without invading any data privacy. By performing this evaluation in a methodical manner, a solid machine-readable base has been created for enterprise-wide management of autonomous AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Traccia，一个基于 OpenTelemetry 构建的七层 AI 治理平台，旨在将 LLM 与自主 AI 代理的运行时遥测数据自动转化为符合欧盟 AI 法案的可验证合规证据，解决现有碎片化工具在 AI 对齐漂移、SaaS 风险和影子 AI 部署方面的"最后一公里"治理难题。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 与自主 AI 代理的快速部署，AI 系统的非确定性、无限状态空间使得传统静态软件治理（SBOM、单元测试、离线基准测试）失效。现有工具（LLM 评估平台如 Langfuse/LangSmith、MLOps 工具如 MLflow、通用 APM 如 Datadog、企业 GRC 工具如 Credo AI）各自孤立，缺乏将运行时遥测与监管合规要求（如欧盟 AI 法案第 12、14、19、26(6)、50 条）连接起来的统一机制，导致合规沦为文档驱动而非证据驱动。
AI.method: 提出四层 AI 治理分类法（模型级、流水线级、运行时级、合规级），并基于此设计 Traccia 的七层垂直架构：(1) AI 系统层、(2) 运行时插桩层（OTel SDK，init()/@observe() 装饰器/guardrail_span()，PII 脱敏）、(3) 遥测智能层（解析 OTLP，构造 DAG，归一化 token/延迟/成本）、(4) 可观测性平台层（仪表板、Trace Explorer、阈值策略）、(5) 护栏检测与策略执行层（三层分类：Tier A 显式护栏、Tier B 提供商信号、Tier C 启发式；missing-guardrail 评估器）、(6) AI 治理层（Governance Hub、AI 系统注册、Human-in-the-loop、事件管理）、(7) 合规层（生成含 SHA-256 哈希的 Evidence Package，映射欧盟 AI 法案条款）。以"AI 贷款审批助手"为例演示完整生命周期，并与 8 个平台进行四维度对比。
AI.result: Traccia 作为纯 OTLP sidecar，无供应商锁定，可被任何兼容 OTel 收集器摄取；在护栏运行时验证（唯一具备此能力的平台）、基于遥测的合规证据生成（而非自报告问卷）方面显著优于 Arize Phoenix、Langfuse、LangSmith、Braintrust、Maxim AI、Datadog、Credo AI、Holistic AI 等 8 个对比平台；通过将 EU AI Act 条款映射到 OTel span 属性，自动生成包含 FRIA、向 Article 12/14/19/26(6)/50/72/73 对齐的证据包与不可篡改审计日志。
AI.conclusion: Traccia 定位为"运行时治理基础设施"，与评估工程平台和企业 GRC 平台互补而非竞争；通过将治理作为执行的自然副产物，实现了无需开发者编写额外合规代码即可持续产出机器可验证证据的闭环。未来工作将扩展至运行时主动执行拦截、以及 HIPAA、SOC 2、ISO/IEC 42001、美国行政命令等更多合规框架适配器。

title: CIPHER: A Decoupled Exploration-Selection Framework for Test-Time Scaling of Data Science Agents
summary: Data science tasks span from closed-ended information extraction to open-ended analysis, presenting significant challenges for automation. Recent AI agents powered by language models show promise for handling such complex tasks. However, existing agents typically rely on a single initial state that conditions the entire agent's execution, making them vulnerable to cascading errors initiated by a suboptimal initial state. To mitigate this, we present CIPHER, an automated data science agent that leverages test-time scaling through the generation and selection of multiple initial states for concurrent execution. Unlike existing works on test-time scaling of AI agents, CIPHER explicitly decouples the generation of candidate initial states from their strategic selection for parallel execution. Through extensive evaluation on two benchmarks (closed-form and open-form tasks), we demonstrate that CIPHER exceeds state-of-the-art performance in matched-model comparisons, and remains competitive against larger-model baselines despite relying on a substantially smaller base LM. Our empirical study characterizes the design space of the Decoupled Exploration-Selection (DES) framework: we quantify how generation strategy, selection strategy, and aggregator model capacity contribute to overall performance, and derive actionable design recommendations for practitioners.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CIPHER——一种基于"解耦探索-选择"（DES）框架的数据科学智能体，通过测试时缩放（test-time scaling）生成并筛选多个初始计划并行执行，以缓解单一初始状态引发的级联错误。在 Infi-DA-Bench（封闭式）和 InsightBench（开放式）两个基准上，CIPHER 在匹配模型条件下超越现有最优水平，且以更小的基础 LM 取得接近更大模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于语言模型的数据科学智能体通常仅依赖单一初始状态（如高层计划）来驱动整个执行流程，一旦初始状态欠佳便会引发级联错误。虽然测试时缩放（并行执行多个方案后聚合）已被证明有效，但既有工作将候选生成与执行选择耦合在一起，限制了对初始状态质量杠杆的利用。因此，作者提出将候选生成与策略选择解耦，以更系统地提升智能体性能。
AI.method: CIPHER 的核心是 DES 框架，包含三阶段：(1) 生成 N 个候选初始计划（Planner 代理），可采用 ensemble（多提示采样）、independent（同提示独立采样）或 conditional（以前序候选为条件）三种模式；(2) 从 N 个候选中选择 M 个进入并行执行（Selection），支持 random、entropy（最大熵贪心）、clustering（k-means 选最近质心）和 alignment（LLM 评判）四种策略；(3) 聚合 M 条并行执行结果（Aggregator），可采用 self（同基础 LM）或 leader（升级为更强 LM，如带推理的 Sonnet 3.7）。智能体采用 LangGraph 实现有向图流程，集成特征建议、代码迭代优化（Coder-Analyzer-Editor 循环）和结果总结节点。实验覆盖 24 种配置 × 2 个 M 取值 × 2 个基准 = 96 组测量，每组 3 个随机种子，使用 Claude 3.5 Haiku（基础）与 Sonnet 3.7（leader）。
AI.result: (1) 预算影响：选择预算 M 从 3 增至 5 在两基准上分别带来 +1.9pp 和 +1.4pp 增益，但呈现边际递减；生成预算 N 从 10 增至 30 在 InsightBench 上增益扩大（+4.7→+6.2pp），而在 Infi-DA-Bench 上反而缩小（+9.1→+8.0pp），表明多样性仅在开放式任务中有效。(2) 聚合策略：leader 聚合显著优于 self 聚合（Infi-DA-Bench: Δ=+2.81pp, d=1.59；InsightBench: Δ=+4.52pp, d=1.65，p<0.001）。(3) 生成策略：DES 框架优势仅在 leader 聚合下显现；ensemble 策略在 60% 的匹配条件下排名第一，熵显著高于 base 和 conditional。(4) 选择策略：Maxent 产生最高选择熵，但与下游准确性无直接关联。(5) 综合排序：Ensemble+Goal-Align 为推荐默认配置（各面板排名不低于 5），Ensemble 家族在 10000 种权重采样下占据 1.65× 期望的 top-3 份额。(6) 对比 SOTA：在匹配模型条件下，CIPHER† 在 Infi-DA-Bench 达 81.06%（+7.0pp vs DataWise），CIPHER⋆ 达 82.23%（+8.2pp）；在 InsightBench 达 49.53% 与 50.39%（+10.9pp 与 +11.8pp vs Agent-Poirot），Welch p<0.01；代价为约 5× 输入令牌。(7) 任务类型差异：测试时缩放对高效模型在封闭式任务上增益更大（Haiku +10.0pp vs Sonnet +4.3pp），而对强模型在开放式任务上增益更大（Sonnet +7.8pp vs Haiku +5.5pp）。
AI.conclusion: DES 框架通过解耦候选生成与策略选择，显著提升了数据科学智能体的测试时缩放效率。核心启示：(1) 聚合器节点是支撑整个框架性能的关键；(2) ensemble 生成是产生真正计划多样性的唯一有效来源；(3) 选择熵本身并非充分条件，需结合更智能的筛选机制；(4) 测试时缩放增益随任务类型和模型能力呈非均匀分布。CIPHER 以更小基础 LM 接近更大模型 SOTA 性能，验证了 DES 框架的成本效益。局限包括未做完全算力匹配对比（如多数投票基线）、未利用 token 级概率做更细粒度选择、验证局限于数据科学领域。未来方向包括扩展 ensemble 规模、采用基于梯度的候选选择方法。

title: Chat2Scenic: An Iterative RAG-Based Framework for Scenario Generation in Autonomous Driving
comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
summary: Validating autonomous driving systems requires diverse, regulation-compliant test scenarios. In simulation-based testing, scenarios are defined as executable scripts. Yet automatically generating such scripts from regulatory descriptions remains an open challenge, and existing approaches face fundamental trade-offs. Retrieval-assemble methods achieve reasonable compilation rates but lack scalability, whereas retrieval-based full-script generation suffers from low compilation success rates. We present Chat2Scenic, the first iterative retrieval-augmented framework to generate scenario scripts in Domain Specific Language (DSL). Specifically, Chat2Scenic provides a chatbot interface that supports interactive scenario refinement and integrates Retrieval-augmented Generation (RAG) to ground scenario generation in regulatory knowledge and DSL syntax. Furthermore, we propose an open benchmark for scenario generation comprising 123 scenarios from various regulations, including NHTSA and United Nations Vehicle Regulations, as well as other sources. Extensive evaluation with State-of-the-Art (SOTA) Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrates that Chat2Scenic achieves 76.42% Compilation Success Rate (CSR) and 58.17% Framework Accuracy (FA), outperforming existing methods (Retrieval Assemble with 30.08% CSR, 11.03% FA and Retrieval full script generation with 16.26% CSR, 10.86% FA). To facilitate future research, we release our code as open source at this https URL .

AI.tldr: Chat2Scenic 是首个面向自动驾驶仿真的迭代式检索增强生成（RAG）框架，能够将自然语言法规描述自动转化为 Scenic DSL 可执行脚本。通过结合交互式模块、双检索器 RAG 模块和迭代式组件生成器，并融合上下文提示（CP）、思维链（CoT）和上下文学习（ICL）等提示技术，在包含 123 个场景的自建基准上达到 76.42% 的编译成功率（CSR）和 58.17% 的框架准确率（FA），显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶系统（ADS）的验证需要多样化且符合法规的测试场景，而仿真测试中场景以可执行脚本形式定义。从法规描述自动生成此类脚本仍是开放挑战：现有检索-组装方法虽编译率尚可但缺乏可扩展性和泛化能力，而检索式全脚本生成方法编译成功率低下。此外，现有方法多基于简化场景描述，缺乏对真实法规规范（如 NHTSA、联合国车辆法规）的支持。
AI.method: Chat2Scenic 框架由三大模块构成：(1) 交互式模块——基于 Gradio 的聊天界面，将用户查询解析为包含全局配置 G 和场景组件 S_int={R(空间关系), E(自车行为), O(对象集合), T(限制条件)} 的逻辑结构，支持多轮迭代细化；(2) RAG 模块——采用双检索器架构，分别检索代码片段数据库（基于 all-MiniLM-L6-v2 语义检索）和文档数据库（BM25 + 嵌入模型的混合检索，经 RRF 融合）；(3) 生成模块——按依赖顺序迭代生成 Scenic 代码组件（Generator_R → Generator_E → Generator_O → Generator_T），并集成 CP、CoT、ICL 和 RAG-ICL（含 CodeICL 和 DocICL）四种提示技术。此外，还构建了涵盖 CARLA Leaderboard、NHTSA 及联合国车辆法规 R152/R157/R171 共 123 个场景的开源基准，并提出基于分层模型的人工对齐评估指标（RL/TI/TM/DO/EN）和框架准确率 FA = CSR × SQ。
AI.result: 在 123 个场景基准上的实验表明：(1) 消融实验中，最优配置 C11（CP+CoT+ICL+CodeICL）配合 Gemini-3-Flash 取得 CSR 76.42%、SQ 76.12%、FA 58.17%，显著优于零样本基线（C1：0%）和单独 CP（C4：CSR 12.20%）；(2) 加入 DocICL（C12）反而降低性能，说明文档更适合交互式概念理解而非直接代码生成指导；(3) CodeICL 能显著缩短响应时间（如 C11 的 RT=222s vs C9 的 520s）；(4) 跨模型对比中 Gemini-3-Flash 表现最佳，开源模型（Qwen3、Mistral、Gemma3 等）CSR 几乎为 0（0–1.62%），因其规模较小且难以遵循复杂组合提示；(5) 与 SOTA 方法对比，Chat2Scenic 远超 ChatScene（CSR 30.08%, FA 11.03%）和 NL2Scenic（CSR 16.26%, FA 10.86%）。虽然迭代生成导致响应时间较长（222s），但对于离线场景生成是可接受的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了首个用于自动驾驶场景生成的迭代式 RAG 框架 Chat2Scenic，并构建了首个基于真实法规的 123 场景基准及多维评估指标，验证了 CP+CoT+ICL+CodeICL 组合提示策略的显著优势，确立了新的 SOTA 性能。代码已开源以促进后续研究。未来工作将扩展多模态输入（图像、草图）以及仿真在环（simulation-in-the-loop）反馈机制，以进一步提升场景规约与生成精度。

title: A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Models for Long and Short-Term Forecasting of the Egyptian Stock Market: A Focus on EGX30
summary: This study concentrates on predicting stock prices in the Egyptian market, focusing on the EGX30, an influential financial hub in the Middle East. While most research focuses on global stocks, there's a growing need to understand stock trends in developing countries like Egypt. The study compares different machine learning models for forecasting EGX30 trends, covering short and long-term predictions. Using historical EGX30 data, including metrics like root mean squared error, Mean Absolute Percentage Error, and coefficient of determination, models like K-Nearest Neighbours, random forest, extreme gradient boosting, long short-term memory networks, and gated recurrent unit networks were evaluated. The goal is to determine the most effective models for EGX30 prediction, considering Egypt's unique market dynamics. Insights from this study aid investors in making informed decisions. Results show that the Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) outperformed the other models in the one-week, one-month, and two-months while the eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) model outperformed others in the one-day predictions, highlighting their usefulness in predictive analysis for financial markets. The study also showed the importance of using the ensemble techniques, especially in the long-term predictions which proved better results reaching 5 times the GRU in the two-month predictions. Additionally, the study notes the surprisingly good performance of K-Nearest Neighbours (KNN) on long-term predictions, suggesting its enduring relevance and potential for future applications in the fintech domains.

AI.tldr: 本文针对埃及股票市场 EGX30 指数，系统比较了 7 种传统机器学习模型（KNN、决策树、随机森林、Extra Trees、XGBoost、AdaBoost、LightGBM）与 2 种深度学习模型（LSTM、GRU）在不同时间跨度（1 天、1 周、1 个月、2 个月）下的预测性能，并引入集成混合（blending）技术。研究发现：XGBoost 在单日预测中最优，GRU 在中长周期（周/月/双月）预测中最优，KNN 在长期预测中出乎意料地表现良好，而集成模型在长期预测中将 RMSE 降至单模型 GRU 的约 1/5，显著提升了稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有股价预测研究多集中于成熟市场，对埃及等新兴市场的特殊市场动态缺乏系统研究；同时当地投资者普遍缺乏技术分析能力，亟需基于机器学习的可解释预测工具辅助决策。本文以中东重要金融枢纽 EGX30 指数为对象，填补发展中国家市场预测研究的空白，并赋能普通投资者。
AI.method: （1）数据：EGX30 历史数据，加入时间特征（星期/季度等），并基于相关性分析与多重共线性问题剔除冗余；（2）特征工程：引入 11 项技术指标（SMA、EMA、布林带、CCI、RSI 等），并叠加滞后特征（lag features）与滚动窗口以捕获时序依赖；（3）模型：9 个基模型 + 基于 blending 技术的集成模型（每周期选 Top-3）；（4）评估：滚动预测（rolling forecast）+ Adam 优化器，指标采用 RMSE、MAPE、R²；（5）预测跨度划分为短期（1 天、1 周）与长期（1 月、2 月）。
AI.result: ① 单日预测：XGBoost 最优（RMSE=0.0163, MAPE=0.0187, R²=0.993），LightGBM 与随机森林紧随其后；② 一周预测：GRU 最优（RMSE=0.0406, MAPE=0.0535, R²=0.961），随机森林与 Extra Trees 表现接近；③ 一月预测：GRU 显著领先（RMSE=0.078, R²=0.865），LSTM 第二，值得注意的是 KNN 从短期劣势跃升为第三（RMSE=0.107），传统 boosting 模型普遍出现 R² 为负；④ 双月预测：GRU 仍最佳（RMSE=0.12, R²=0.685），KNN 与 LSTM 继续位居前列，多数传统 ML 模型 R² 转负；⑤ 集成模型：在长期预测上表现尤为突出，双月 RMSE=0.0205，约为 GRU 的 1/5，一月 RMSE=0.0284，但单日精度低于 XGBoost（因日间波动较大）。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明：（1）深度学习模型 GRU 在中长周期预测中持续占优，验证了其对时序依赖与季节性特征的捕获能力；（2）XGBoost 凭借对日内波动的拟合优势成为单日预测最佳选择；（3）KNN 在长期预测中的意外表现揭示了基于实例的相似性匹配在捕捉趋势性宏观规律方面的潜力；（4）blending 集成策略可显著提升长期预测稳定性，是单模型的有效补充。局限与展望：未来将引入 Transformer 架构与基于新闻/社交媒体的情感分析，进一步融合基本面与情绪面信号。

title: CatalogAgent: A Supervisor-mediated Self-Learning System Enabling Context Engineering for GenAI Models
summary: Product catalogs are the backbone of e-commerce sites, yet a large number of structured attributes (SAs) -- such as material, color, and shape -- often have missing values. Typically, SA values are extracted from product information, including titles and descriptions. While LLM-based generator-evaluator frameworks have demonstrated effectiveness for SA prediction -- where an LLM generates SA values and another evaluates them -- they face challenges when the Generator and Evaluator produce conflicting outputs, as either component can make mistakes. We introduce \texttt{CatalogAgent}, a novel agentic system that continuously improves Generator and Evaluator models for e-commerce catalog enrichment. When disagreements arise from (1) internal conflicts between the LLM-based Generator and Evaluator, or (2) external feedback from sellers on LLM outputs, a Supervisor Agent intervenes to mediate these conflicts and make final decisions. The system also incorporates a Memory Base and a Memory Summarizer that stores Supervisor Agent activities from individual cases and aggregates patterns into learnings. These learnings are fed back to the worker Generator and Evaluator LLMs, enabling self-improvement without human intervention. Through context engineering -- injecting learnings and insights into worker LLMs' contexts -- the system successfully transfers the Supervisor's capabilities to the Generator and Evaluator, improving their performance by 15.24\% and 13.98\%, respectively. Our experiments demonstrate a new paradigm of Supervisor Agent-mediated self-learning systems for improving generative AI model accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CatalogAgent，一种面向电商目录富集场景的监督者智能体介导的自学习系统。该系统通过监督者智能体（Supervisor Agent）调解生成器（Generator）与评估器（Evaluator）之间的冲突，利用记忆库（Memory Base）和记忆摘要器（Memory Summarizer）将个体案例学习聚合为通用知识，再通过上下文工程（提示优化、元数据完善、图像效用分析）反馈至工作模型，实现无人工干预的持续自我改进。
AI.motivation: 电商产品目录依赖大量结构化属性（如材质、颜色、形状），但缺失值问题严重。基于 LLM 的"生成器-评估器"框架虽有效，但在两者产生冲突输出时缺乏仲裁机制，且无法系统性地识别和修正高层级错误模式。生产级目录富集需要轻量级低成本模型，同时要保证大规模部署下的准确性，这要求一种系统化的上下文工程方法在不牺牲可扩展性的前提下最大化模型性能。
AI.method: 系统由四个核心模块组成：（1）生成器与评估器：基于 Mistral-NeMo 的轻量级 LLM，分别负责属性值预测与质量验证；（2）监督者智能体：基于 Claude Sonnet，采用 ReAct 范式进行多步工具增强推理，调解两类冲突（生成器-评估器冲突、模型-卖家冲突），生成三类上下文工程洞察（提示改进、元数据完善、图像效用分析）；（3）记忆库：以结构化模式存储个体案例的监督者活动记录；（4）记忆摘要器：将细粒度案例洞察按 PT-A（产品类型-属性）对聚合为通用学习。系统通过受约束优化（最小化分歧率，同时保证黄金数据集上的精度不退化）实现回归安全的上下文更新，形成闭环自学习循环。附录还提供了 G-E-S 框架对目录精度与准确性影响的理论分析（切片分解与定理证明）。
AI.result: 实验基于 4.89 万对生成器-评估器分歧数据、5 万对测试数据和 2.3 万对卖家反馈数据。主要结果包括：（1）监督者智能体表现优异——在生成角色上准确率 97.26%，在评估角色上准确率 94.56%，模型-卖家分歧仲裁精确率 85.65%、召回率 94.28%；（2）通过上下文工程，生成器性能提升 15.24%，评估器性能提升 13.98%；（3）元数据更新使部分 PT-A 准确率提升达 5%（如 Shirt-shirt form type 从 87.95% 升至 92.54%）；（4）提示注入带来更显著提升，如 Cellular Phone Case-model name 从 69.20% 提升至 84.21%（+15.01%）；（5）回归测试在黄金数据集上验证，大部分 PT-A 通过约束检查（如 Nail Polish-material type free 精确率提升 +11.53%、召回率提升 +17.50%），少数不达标者被拒绝更新；（6）图像效用分析支持为不同 PT-A 路由最优模型配置（文本或多模态、主图或多图）。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出了一种新型监督者智能体介导的自学习范式，验证了在无需人工干预和模型权重更新的前提下，通过挖掘冲突案例、利用监督者深度推理、记忆聚合和上下文工程可显著提升生成式 AI 模型的准确性。系统具备高度可扩展性，可集成卖家和客户反馈等多源信号。未来方向是利用监督者生成的高质量标签对生成器和评估器进行微调，进一步突破上下文工程的性能上限。

title: Instrument Effects in Language-Model Honesty Evaluation: An Auditable Single-System Demonstration
comment: 21 pages. Code: this https URL (tag v1.0-arxiv). Data: this https URL
summary: Evaluations of language-model honesty read the model's verdicts as evidence about the model. We test the instrument instead. We built a text-adventure world where the game engine, not any model, knows whether the quest can be completed. A language model plays under a budget and must eventually declare its quest complete, unreachable, or not yet decidable; the engine scores every verdict. Decision rules were recorded before results were read, and run artifacts bind the revisions they executed; the strength of preregistration varies by series and is disclosed. With the player held fixed, instrument choices substantially changed measured behavior. On four byte-identical anchors, expanding a two-verdict grammar to three verdicts moved strong claims from 38/40 to 7/40, while the new incomplete verdict took 28/40 outcomes; across series 2, 93/158 valid games ended incomplete. One sentence disclosing the success criterion took matched-instance false verdicts from 18/59 to 0/58, through fewer decision points and cleaner decisions. Repeated runs of one fixed configuration produced non-stable verdict distributions on 3 of 4 instances: single runs report samples as dispositions. A formally preregistered narrative-register gradient was falsified; two post-hoc, hypothesis-generating patterns remain: register presence roughly doubled strong claims, and budget rendering moved verdicts more than register content (.383 meter vs .150 lantern).
